data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description: We are looking for a hands-on Autonomous Drone Software Engineer to join a swarming programme. As an engineer on a lean, high-impact team, you will have the opportunity to drive development of new features, have a say in architecture and design decisions and have real impact across all the team’s projects. You will not be siloed; this role spans the entire autonomy lifecycle, from developing autonomy capabilities to investigating real-world flight-test data. The ideal candidate is someone who’s a self-starter, can work independently, can work with ambiguity, can take decisions on their own and not be afraid to drive and push towards getting the project across the finish line. Responsibilities and Duties Take ownership and drive the development of new features across the autonomy stack and partner integrations Collaborate closely with hardware engineers, product managers, and external partners to define system requirements and translate them into robust software architecture Design and implement robust distributed state machines, leader election protocols, and fault-tolerant architectures. Deliver clean, readable and maintainable code while confidently managing complex concurrency and contention scenarios Develop and run rigorous tests utilizing SITL/HITL simulation environments to validate code prior to physical deployment Actively participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and technical documentation to elevate the team's engineering standards Act decisively during flight-test investigations, applying strong engineering judgment to physical failure modes and release safety Qualifications and Skills 3+ years of professional engineering experience in robotics, embedded systems, or distributed systems. Deep proficiency in modern C++, with practical experience designing, reasoning about, and debugging highly concurrent systems. Embedded systems experience working close to hardware on real-time or safety-critical platforms (e.g., avionics, automotive, robotics). Strong architectural understanding of distributed systems, with the ability to deliberately evaluate and select consensus designs. Familiarity with robust release management, versioned artifacts, and pinned dependencies. Experience with PX4, MAVLink, and related drone software ecosystems is a plus EU citizenship required Benefits Flexible working hours Stock Options Generous holiday allowance Pension plan Extended social security package Enhanced maternity & paternity leave Wellpass membership About Auterion We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems. At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters. data.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
data.description: As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. Responsibilities and Duties Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges. Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up. Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations. Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required. Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode. Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations. Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes. Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack. Qualifications and Skills Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP) Hands-on hardware-software integration: system bring-up, wiring and connectors, and embedded interfaces (UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) at a practical level Structured troubleshooting: you can isolate whether a problem is software, hardware, configuration or RF, often under time pressure in the field Strong communicator: you can explain technical issues clearly to customers and operators, and report findings back to engineering in a way they can act on Willing to travel and work on-site with customers, including at test ranges and in field environments EU citizenship (required for security clearance and customer requirements) Nice-to-have Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, QGroundControl or mission planning tools UAV flight testing and validation in operational environments Experience with datalinks and radio systems Previous customer-facing or field engineering role, especially with defense or government customers German language skills Benefits Flexible working hours Stock Options Generous holiday allowance Pension plan Extended social security package Enhanced maternity & paternity leave Wellpass membership About Auterion We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems. At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexere Gesellschaftsstrukturen und mehrstufige Beteiligungsmodelle. Die Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen gehört ebenso zu Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich wie die eigenständige bilanzielle Beurteilung der betreuten Gesellschaften. Abschlüsse erstellen Sie nach den Vorgaben des HGB; Kenntnisse bzw. Erfahrungen im Bereich der Rechnungslegung nach KAGB sind dabei besonders willkommen. Sie stellen die fristgerechte Aufbereitung verschiedener interner sowie externer Auswertungen und Reportings sicher. Darüber hinaus erstellen Sie Ergebnisprognosen, Hochrechnungen und aussagekräftige Plan-Ist-Analysen. Bei bilanziellen oder buchhalterischen Fragestellungen stehen Sie im Austausch mit Wirtschaftsprüfern, Geschäftspartnern sowie internen Ansprechpartnern. Sie wirken aktiv bei der Klärung und Lösung komplexerer Sachverhalte mit und sorgen für eine verlässliche Zahlenbasis. Sie beherrschen die relevanten Bereiche der Buchhaltung – von Sachkonten über Debitoren und Kreditoren bis hin zur Anlagenbuchhaltung. In der eigenständigen Erstellung und Betreuung von Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB sind Sie sicher. Kenntnisse im Bereich KAGB bzw. der Rechnungslegung von Fonds- und Kapitalverwaltungsgesellschaften sind ein Plus. Mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen arbeiten Sie routiniert. Erfahrungen mit SAP sind von Vorteil. Eine gewissenhafte, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise zeichnet Sie aus. Sie arbeiten gerne im Team, sind zuverlässig und behalten auch bei anspruchsvollen Themen den Überblick. Neue Aufgabenstellungen gehen Sie pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert an. Benefits Ein abwechslungsreiches Tätigkeitsfeld mit anspruchsvollen Aufgaben im Fonds- und Immobilienumfeld. Eine attraktive Vergütung sowie zusätzliche Leistungen zur Unterstützung Ihrer privaten Altersvorsorge. Ein strukturierter Onboarding-Prozess mit umfassender Einarbeitung und fachlicher Unterstützung durch erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen. data.description: Über uns Gute Bars leben von guten Geschichten. Von unvergesslichen Abenden, spontanen Begegnungen, guter Musik und Menschen, die gerne wiederkommen. Du arbeitest eigenständig, zuverlässig und bringst gerne eigene Ideen ein. Du hast Lust auf Gastronomie, Events und das Bonner Nachtleben. Du bist zeitlich flexibel genug, um gelegentlich auch abends oder am Wochenende Content vor Ort zu produzieren. Besonders wichtig ist uns dein kreatives Gespür. Entscheidend ist, dass du gute Ideen hast und sie auch umsetzen kannst. Kurze Entscheidungswege: Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen, ohne komplizierte Freigabeprozesse. Abwechslungsreiche Projekte: Unterschiedliche Bars, Veranstaltungen und Zielgruppen sorgen für immer neue kreative Möglichkeiten. data.title: Senior Conversion Design Analyst (f/m/d)
data.description: Your mission We're looking for a Senior Conversion Design Analyst who is genuinely both things: a designer who digs into data, and an analyst who designs. You decide with evidence. You will frame real user problems based on qualitative and quantitative data, design a part of our product, form a view about what should change, build the experiment that tests it, and analyze the results yourself. You will sit inside the product delivery team that focuses on user growth, working closely with the person accountable for that part of the business and with the engineers building it. And you will not be doing it alone: You join a group of Conversion Design Analysts across the company who work the same way and hold each other's standards. English is our working language. German matters here too: You will be designing flows that German-speaking users read. Concretely, you will: Design experiences grounded in real user needs and real neighbourhood life. Your job is to design flows and screens that are highly usable and intuitive and that earn their place by adding measurable value, not just because we can build them. Frame the real problem before solving it. Dig into quantitative and qualitative data until you find the actual question underneath the ask. Then make it explainable and actionable. A well-framed problem is half the battle Design, run the experiment, read it honestly and decide what comes next. Define a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome. Then use what you learned to frame the next question. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, and designing the next step. Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. You will spend real time with the people who use this, because you cannot A/B test your way to understanding somebody. Direct AI, and spend your judgment where it counts. AI produces a lot of our first-pass design. You will brief it, push back on it, and hold the quality bar, so your own hours go to the thinking a model cannot do. Argue for cutting things. Adding is easy. You will help decide what earns its place and what should be removed, and be willing to make the case for less. Your profile You practice product design and analytics. You might come from an analyst background and bring a love of design and design thinking, or vice versa. You have run experiments end to end and know how to move from one to the next. Setting up the hypothesis, designing strong variants using our design system, choosing the right metrics to track, analyzing the results and then making a clear call on how to continue: ship it, kill it, or iterate. You have technical know-how and experience in setting up and evaluating experiments in an A/B testing tool, constructing the needed dashboards for the problem space you are working on. With sufficient data literacy, you get your own numbers through SQL query. You work with raw data to dig up insights and spot opportunities, without waiting for someone else to pull it for you. You have statistical literacy. You don’t need to be able to run R, but you understand what Bayesian vs. frequentist is about and why you do a power analysis before launching an experiment. You care about craft and are attentive to details. You can tell the difference between good enough and actually good and you design experiences people do not have to think about. You present your work clearly, defend your decisions when challenged, and are comfortable in front of a crowd. You are fluent with AI tools. This role allows you to have more control and impact through both design and analysis, but to do this well you'll need to leverage (and at times extend) our AI enablement stack Excellent English skills for working in our international team. To apply, include a cover letter explaining why this role and why now and if your background doesn't tick every box, tell us how you'd bridge the gap. Alongside it, share a portfolio that shows your work through its impact, at least one project walked through end to end: the hypothesis, what you designed, the result, and what you took from it. Show us how you used data to move your thinking forward, and where experimentation shaped what you built. If you can't share a portfolio due to an NDA or the nature of your work, a detailed cover letter walking through a project in the same way is fine. Nice to have Experience with a marketplace, community, classifieds, or other network product. Strong German, or the confidence to design in it with support. Experience building or maintaining parts of a design system. Comfortable writing SQL without AI assistance. You have basic dbt knowledge. What we offer Hybrid work model combining office and remote days A meaningful job – we're creating a great product with real added value for the community Work in a cheerful and experienced team that exchanges ideas and learns from each other Insights into the entire work process of our social startup and the nebenan.de foundation Responsibility and great opportunities to actively contribute Your nebenan.de SpenditCard – you'll receive an additional income of 35 Euros per month, which you can use for things of your choice 30 days of vacation per year – we also offer the possibility of workation models and a sabbatical A workplace in Berlin-Kreuzberg and regular events like yoga or Lunch & Learn sessions. If we’ve captured your interest, apply now and let us know why you’re the perfect fit for the job! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

data.title: Product Engineer (Growth) // AI Music Video Platform
data.description: Neural Frames is a leading AI music video generator, turning any song into a fully produced music video in minutes. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and generating more than $5M in annualized revenue. Our ambition is to build a category-defining company that helps tens of millions of audio creators visualize their content and promote it online. The next target is a $15M run rate. We're hiring our first product engineer focused on growth. You'll own our marketing pages and the surfaces that turn attention into revenue: free tools, landing pages, signup, onboarding, paywalls, and pricing. You'll also ship on the core product itself. Wherever the biggest lever is, that's where you build. This is a builder role. You'll ship production code daily, look at the results, decide what to test next, and be one of the people most directly responsible for taking us from $5M to $15M and ultimately to $100M. As a profitable company, there is no VC drama. We are a small, ambitious group of people striving to build something creators love. Tasks Own our marketing pages: build, maintain, and continuously improve the landing pages and site experiences that bring people into Neural Frames, and keep them fast, high-converting, and visible in traditional search, Google AI Overviews, and AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity Turn our free tools into real product entry points, where users get immediate value and then continue into Neural Frames without losing their song, lyrics, artwork, or progress Run conversion experiments across the whole funnel: landing pages, calls to action, signup, onboarding, paywalls, packaging, and pricing Ship on the core product when that's where the growth lever is, especially product-native loops: shareable creations, templates, embeds, referrals, and public pages that give creators a reason to spread Neural Frames for us Run programmatic SEO experiments without creating low-quality pages, index bloat, or content that exists only for search engines Build lifecycle experiments tied to real product behavior: activation, abandoned projects, paywall recovery, feature discovery, re-engagement Make sure our Conversion Tracking is set up correctly Own growth measurement and data quality across PostHog, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and our backend payment data: build funnels and dashboards you can trust, investigate unexpected movements, and turn them into decisions Requirements You're a product engineer who can independently ship production experiences with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, and you sweat the details that make pages convert: speed, layout, copy, polish You're comfortable moving into backend and data work when necessary. Our backend is written in Python, and you can work with APIs, SQL, event data, and attribution logic You think like a marketer as much as an engineer: you have real opinions about headlines, page structure, and pricing pages, and you'd rather be measured on signups and revenue than on tickets closed You think through the complete funnel. A page that ranks is not a win if visitors don't activate, pay, and stick around You understand experimentation: hypothesis, primary metric, guardrails, and a decision threshold defined before the test goes live You have strong product and editorial judgment. You build useful experiences for humans rather than filling the internet with generic AI-generated pages You use AI tools as a genuine extension of how you work, with a high bar for accuracy, originality, and brand quality You have high agency: you identify the bottleneck, gather the evidence, ship a solution, and communicate results without waiting for a perfectly specified ticket You're based in Berlin and can join us in the office at least four days per week Bonus points: You've personally built something that produced meaningful organic or product-led growth: a startup, a free tool, a programmatic SEO engine, or growth ownership at a product company. We care more about attributable revenue than impressive traffic screenshots You know technical SEO well: crawling, indexing, structured data, internal linking, canonicalization, and safe migrations Benefits VSOPs & Profit Sharing. Bi-weekly team lunches, regular team events, an annual summer offsite, learning & development support, productivity tools, a one-time headphone budget, Deutschlandticket, and a €5,000 referral bonus. neural frames is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all. data.description: Bringe Technik in große Bauwerke im Stahlwasserbau! data.description: Ihre Aufgaben Du analysierst unsere End-to-End-Kundenprozesse von der ersten Datenaufnahme über Unterlagenbeschaffung, Dienstleistersteuerung und Gutachtenerstellung bis hin zu Rechnung und Mahnwesen. Du bist näher an der Lösung als an der Theorie. In Deiner täglichen Arbeit stehst Du im engen Austausch mit unseren anderen Teamverantwortlichen. Sie liefern Dir das Fachwissen, Du übersetzt es in Prozesse und Systeme . Gemessen wirst Du an Deinen zentralen Kennzahlen, und machst diese Größen für die gesamte Organisation transparent. Mittelfristig baust Du Dir das Team auf, das Du brauchst, sobald die Potenziale größer werden als das, was Du allein liefern kannst. Wer in welchem Tempo dazu kommt, entscheidest Du datengetrieben. Ihr Profil Du bist t echnisch versiert und arbeitest hands-on mit KI . Du hast hast bereits Systeme und Automatisierungen gebaut, die in echten Geschäftsprozessen laufen. Du musst nicht aus dem Immobilienumfeld kommen, das Fachwissen liefern unsere Expert:innen, Du lieferst die technische Architektur. Du bist daten- und prozessaffin . Du erkennst Muster in Daten, denkst in Inputs und Outputs und kannst manuelle Abläufe so zerlegen, dass sie automatisierbar und integrierbar werden. Du bist generalistisch , Du kannst Dich in ein Thema reindenken, indem Du Dir erklären lässt, wie es heute manuell gemacht wird, und daraus eine elegante technische Lösung entwickeln. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und kannst priorisieren. Du wirst von allen Seiten Wünsche bekommen und Du musst entscheiden können, was zuerst gebaut wird. Du kommunizierst in beide Richtungen souverän, sowohl mit Fachverantwortlichen über deren Prozesse als auch über deren technische Umsetzung. Du bringst Führungspotenzial mit. Du startest allein, baust aber mittelfristig ein Team auf. Du musst keine zehn Jahre Führungserfahrung mitbringen, aber den Willen, ein Team aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln. Deutsch sprichst Du fließend, unsere internen Prozesse, Kunden und externen Partner laufen auf Deutsch. Warum wir? Wir wachsen schnell und wir wollen es so tun, dass jeder einzelne Vorgang schneller, präziser und reibungsloser läuft als heute. Genau dafür suchen wir Dich. data.title: Senior Sales Manager - Media (m/w/d)
data.description: Who We Are Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at verve.com . Der fehlende Wirkungsnachweis ist das größte Problem im stationären Handel für Werbungtreibende. Obwohl Marken Millionen in Werbung am Point of Sale investieren, können sie nicht belegen, ob daraus Käufe wurden. Verve Retail Media (VRM) löst dieses Problem. Wir vermarkten und betreiben digitale Werbe-Screens in mehreren tausend LEH-, Drogerie- und Convenience-Standorten und verbinden sie mit digitalen Coupons, Retargeting im CTV und anderen Offsite-Kanälen. Marken buchen bei uns keine isolierten Werbeformate, sondern 360-Grad-Kampagnen, die zu Hause starten und bis zum Einkaufsregal reichen -eine Closed-Loop-Messung auf Basis realer Kassendaten. VRM ist die eigenständige Retail Media Unit der börsennotierten Verve Group SE. Wir arbeiten wie ein schnell skalierendes Startup mit AI-First-Strategie über alle Funktionen und mit Zugriff auf die Infrastruktur eines internationalen AdTech-Unternehmens mit über einer Billionen ausgelieferter Werbeimpressionen pro Jahr. data.title: Frontend Engineer - Agentic AI
data.description: About Us Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. Your Mission As a Frontend Engineer at Hawk, you will build and maintain the user interface of our agentic AI Investigation Agent. This is the product where compliance analysts configure AI workflows, watch autonomous investigations run, and review, question and act on what the agent concludes. The frontend is a modern TypeScript monorepo made of a host application and a growing set of independently deployable microfrontends. These remotes are designed to be built once and used in two places: our new shadcn/ui-based Investigation Agent and our existing Material UI-based Case Manager. Your job is to understand this codebase deeply, keep it healthy, and ship new features with care, from the component level all the way to how it is built and deployed. What You'll Work On: Features: Build product features end to end in React and TypeScript, such as workflow graph editors, investigation timelines, data-heavy tables and dashboards that make agentic AI output understandable for analysts. Microfrontends: Develop and maintain Module Federation remotes, keep remote/host contracts stable, and make sure features fit into both the Investigation Agent and the MUI-based Case Manager. Design system and data layer: Contribute to our shared shadcn/ui + Tailwind component library (documented in Storybook), and consume our Python/FastAPI backends through OpenAPI-generated clients with TanStack Query and Router. Build, test and deploy: Work in a pnpm + Turborepo monorepo with GitHub Actions CI, Vitest and Playwright tests, and deployments to AWS including per-PR preview environments. Collaboration: Work closely with Product, UX, backend engineers and Data Science, and use AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor as part of your everyday workflow. Your Profile: 3–5 years building and maintaining production React applications, with strong TypeScript and modern React skills (hooks, composition, performance, complex state and forms). Clean frontend architecture: you structure code around features and clear boundaries. You keep UI components presentational and reusable, put data fetching and business logic in hooks and typed API layers, and keep server state separate from local UI state. You prefer composition, small focused components and strict typing, and you treat cross-module contracts as an API. Design-system experience: hands-on work with a component-library approach, ideally shadcn/ui, Radix and Tailwind. Familiarity with Material UI is a strong plus. Microfrontends and delivery: Module Federation or similar runtime composition, shared dependencies and host/remote contracts, plus the build and deployment basics behind them: Vite, monorepos (pnpm workspaces, Turborepo or Nx), CI pipelines (GitHub Actions) Comfort with ambiguity : you're happy working on problems that aren't fully defined yet. You ask the right questions, make sensible assumptions, build a first version and refine it with Product and UX, without waiting for a perfect spec. AI tooling: daily, practical use of AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.). Communication: clear communication in English, and the ability to explain technical decisions to both technical and non-technical colleagues. Bonus: Some Python: enough to read a FastAPI endpoint or Pydantic model, run the backend locally, trace a bug across the API boundary, or open a small backend PR. You don't need to be a backend engineer. Infrastructure as code: exposure to Terraform or AWS CDK. Quality tooling: Storybook-driven development, visual regression testing or accessibility testing. Auth: Auth0/OIDC integration in single-page apps. Domain interest: UX for AI products, or previous work in fintech, RegTech or compliance. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

data.description: ZEAL Network SE is a leading international provider of online lottery products, operating for over 20 years with brands like LOTTO24 and Tipp24. Freiheit+ is one of ZEAL's new German state-licensed social lottery that gives participants the chance to win €5,000 every month for 15 years, plus a one-time prize of €250,000. Every ticket sold supports educational projects, with at least 30% of proceeds directly funding initiatives for a good cause. Freiheit+ perfectly combines the dream of lifelong financial freedom with the opportunity to make a real difference, reflecting ZEAL’s commitment to offering innovative, socially impactful lottery experiences. As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer (f/m/d), you'll be the guardian of product quality, ensuring our solutions meet the highest standards throughout the entire development lifecycle. Your tasks: Technically design, develop and maintain automated tests, complemented by manual and exploratory testing, continuously growing our E2E test coverage in step with the product. Collaborate within a dynamic, cross-functional team including a Product Owner, Software Engineers and a Designer in our agile environment, actively contributing to the development of new products and frontends. Own, shape and refine our test strategies for the frontend, prioritizing based on risk and business impact, with a keen focus on delivering a seamless user experience for our customers while preventing any unwelcome surprises. Proactively communicate test coverage, quality status and risks, enabling the team to make informed delivery decisions. Act according to security, usability, and performance best practices to guarantee a superb user experience. Own, expand and nurture our E2E test pipeline, keeping it stable, fast and reliable, and enabling tests for other teams while offering our own tests for integration into their pipelines. Continuously improve our tests using new technologies and approaches. Build a solid functional and high-level technical understanding of company-wide processes to effectively test complex user flows and identify edge cases. What you offer us: Several years of experience and a strong background in testing web applications. Extensive hands-on experience in creating and maintaining automated frontend tests. Thinking outside the box and exploring multiple ways to test, including E2E UI tests, accessibility, page performance, and more. Active communication and collaboration with other QAs to share knowledge, exchange best practices, and learn from each other. Proficiency in the Playwright test framework using TypeScript, or comparable hands-on experience with other modern E2E frameworks such as Cypress. Experience in maintaining and improving CI/CD test pipelines, including diagnosing and resolving flaky tests. A solid grasp of working within a microservices environment where features are frequently and rapidly released (continuous delivery). data.title: Engineering Manager - Data Platform (m/f/d)
data.description: At Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions. Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees. We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team. Are you ready to join us? Your Job As Engineering Manager, Data Platform at Statista, you’ll lead the engineers building a platform-as-a-product that helps teams manage and share trusted data. You’ll make it easier for data producers to get started while ensuring the platform is secure, reliable and cost-conscious as it grows. You’ll work closely with the Senior Platform Product Manager: they lead product vision and priorities; you lead the people, technical delivery and day-to-day operation of the platform. The role spans Snowflake-based data infrastructure and event streaming via Kafka. What You’ll Do Lead and grow the team. Lead a mixed team of DevOps, software and data engineers with shared ownership, on-call and standards. Grow people through clear expectations, regular feedback and real ownership, and hire as the platform grows. Run the platform as a product. Partner with the Senior Platform Product Manager, make it easy for teams to put their data on the platform: quick setup, fast reviews, clear documentation, and a say in how the platform develops. Work with data producers, Analytics Engineering and other Statista group companies as partners, not just users. Build trust into the platform. Guide the use of access controls, cost safeguards, audits, data contracts and metadata so teams can share data safely with people, APIs and AI-powered applications. Own reliable event streaming. Run Kafka as the backbone that distributes data and content across Statista: reliable, well monitored, and easy for teams to publish to and consume from. Set technical direction. Guide architecture and build-versus-buy decisions, review designs and pull requests, and use AI and automation where they improve the team's work. You'll stay technically engaged without being expected to code every day. Your Skills At least five years of experience leading engineering teams, ideally in data platforms, platform engineering or infrastructure. data.title: Brand Data Production Manager (m/f/d)
data.description: At Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions. Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees. We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team. Are you ready to join us? Your role As Brand Data Production Manager, you are the driving force behind Statista’s brand-related data portfolio. You own the brand data Type as a data product, with decision-making authority over what brand data to produce, develop, maintain, or retire, set priorities and quality bar that guide the teams who build and run the data pipelines. Own the end-to-end lifecycle of brand data domains- including brand market shares, consumer awareness, brand perception, and loyalty metrics- defining the strategic direction, target users, and value proposition and serving as the central point of contact for what brand data should cover and why. Translate market trends, customer needs and use cases into clear coverage priorities and requirements, turning signals from Revenue, Quality, platform and API usage, customer feedback, and industry developments into a prioritized brand data roadmap. Identify data coverage gaps and define pragmatic solutions evaluating potential data sources, proxy data strategies, and methodology trade-offs to close critical gaps, weighing relevance against feasibility in collaboration with production teams. Define and track business-facing KPIs such as coverage of priority brands, data quality, and customer impact; establish and maintain quality gates, data governance standards, and escalation processes across the production pipeline, working with the Quality team to drive continuous improvement. Review and challenge trade-offs proposed by production and engineering teams (e.g. coverage vs. speed, automation vs. accuracy) from a relevance and customer-value perspective, while production line owners retain responsibility for how data is produced. Coordinate cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Content, Product, and commercial stakeholders to resolve dependencies and keep priorities aligned across the organization. Your Profile Strong background in data product management, data operations, market/brand strategy, or business analytics, with the judgment to decide what data matters most and why and a track record of owning and driving a data domain or product area. Degree in a related field and/or equivalent practical experience. Solid understanding of data concepts and statistical reasoning, paired with a strong customer-focused business mindset and an understanding of how data creates value for users. Comfortable setting direction while depending on others for execution; you lead through clarity, prioritization, and evidence rather than direct control of delivery. Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, experienced in translating complex business needs into actionable specifications for technical teams and briefing production teams around clear, well-justified priorities. Clear, confident communicator in English who excels at data storytelling and explains complex topics clearly. A structured, pragmatic, and curious way of working, with an ownership mindset and the ability to stay calm and decisive under pressure. Proficiency in Excel required; SQL and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) and project tools (Jira, Confluence) are a plus. Experience with market research or API-sourced data, Python, or cloud data platforms is an additional advantage. data.title: Flow Lead (m/w/d
data.description: At Knuspr, we’re redefining grocery shopping. Delivering fresh, local produce and everyday essentials to thousands of customers daily requires an ultra-efficient operational backbone. As Flow Lead / Central Flow Lead , you will serve as the central command point for labor allocation and operational flow across our Fulfillment Centers in Germany. Operating from your desk, you will monitor real-time operational performance, dynamically allocate workforce capacity, and coordinate with on-site teams to keep every site running at peak efficiency. Your mission is simple: turn live data into immediate action. By anticipating bottlenecks, balancing labor across sectors, and keeping operations aligned, you’ll ensure every order is processed seamlessly and delivered on time. Why this role is exciting Impact at scale: Directly influence labor allocation and operational output across Germany’s Fulfillment Centers from a single, centralized control tower. Real-time decision-making: Work in a dynamic environment where live data translates directly into high-impact operational adjustments. Smart logistics & tech: Drive performance at the intersection of automation, WMS platforms, and data-driven workforce management. True ownership: Anticipate disruptions, resolve bottlenecks early, and maintain optimal operational flow under pressure. What you’ll do Control the flow: Monitor real-time dashboards and direct automated labor flow by assigning team members across individual sectors through central control tools. Balance capacity dynamically: Adjust workforce distribution and shift plans on the fly in response to fluctuating order volumes and site priorities. Drive operational KPIs: Track CPT (Critical Pull Time), SLAs, idle time, and sector efficiency—identifying bottlenecks early and executing timely interventions. Keep teams aligned: Partner closely with Area Managers, Operations Managers, and on-site shop floor teams to execute adjustments and maintain consistent operational standards. Optimize continuously: Analyze shift performance, identify recurring process gaps, review SOP compliance with site teams, and contribute feedback for next-generation labor management tools. What we are looking for Relevant operational background: Experience in dispatch, logistics, operational planning, supply chain, e-commerce, or fulfillment (experience with automated warehouses or labor scheduling is a plus). Control-tower mindset: Strong ability to connect the dots across complex, fast-paced operations and make confident, data-driven decisions under pressure. Tech confidence: Comfortable steering operations using real-time dashboards, WMS platforms, and automated labor allocation tools. Strong language & communication skills: Very good English for daily operations and reporting, combined with strong Romanian language skills for direct, clear coordination with shop floor teams. Shift availability: Willingness to work in a 3-shift system from Monday to Friday. Structured & proactive approach: A problem-solver who anticipates disruptions rather than just reacting to them. Im Rahmen einer altersbedingten Nachfolge suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die diese Modernisierung konzipiert, gemeinsam mit unseren kaufmännischen und technischen Teams umsetzt und das Asset Management anschließend dauerhaft weiterentwickelt. data.title: Senior Associate, Internal Communications, International
data.description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. About the Company DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt are one global team building the future of local commerce. Our products power millions of interactions between consumers, merchants, and couriers every day, in cities around the world. Together, we're combining global scale with deep local understanding to deliver what's next. In this role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across all three brands. About the Team This role sits within the Global Internal Communications team, a high-impact group focused on engaging and connecting with DoordDash, Deliveroo and Wolt's most important audience: our employees. This role will specifically support the International business (Deliveroo and Wolt) in Europe and the Middle East (EMEA). We are responsible for leading employee communications centred around our company-wide strategy, business goals, and financial results to ensure employees understand the company's near- and long-term vision. This team works cross-functionally with key business stakeholders, touching every corner of the organisation. About the Role Reporting to the Senior Manager, International Internal Communications, you will provide support across the Deliveroo and Wolt businesses including being the key internal comms point of contact for our EMEA country teams, working on change and issues communications, and partnering on content creation and relevant internationally focused projects. This role is ideal for someone with between 5-10 years of communications experience who is experienced in working with multiple stakeholders in fast paced but sometimes ambiguous environments. You will partner closely with the Senior Manager to translate complex or evolving information into clear, effective communications for employees. Day to day you'll be: Acting as the main internal comms point of contact for Deliveroo and Wolt (EMEA) country teams and regional communications managers Building and maintaining the community of internal communicators across the EMEA footprint, sharing best practice and editorial guidance and keeping consistency with international IC standards. Supporting crisis and issues communications across EMEA, partnering with the Senior Director and Senior Managers Providing change management comms support, partnering with the change management comms lead and people team on delivery. Creating content to support company level events, such as all hands Leading on analytics and measurement for such events for the international internal comms team, working closely with the digital channels team. Operating effectively as part of a global team partnering with the international business. We're excited about you because… You have a strong (5yrs +) track record of communications experience. You work well with multiple stakeholders across countries and brands, and can build and sustain a network of communicators. You thrive in fast paced, sometimes ambiguous environments, and stay effective when situations move quickly. You can translate complex or evolving information into clear, effective communications for employees. You are comfortable supporting crisis, issues and change communications. You are comfortable with data, and can turn engagement reporting into insights. You are flexible and can turn your hand to a wide range of comms projects and topics Next steps Step 1: Apply before Mon 26th October Step 2: Screening with our recruitment team Step 3: Panel interview with hiring manager and team lead Step 4: Written test and final interview Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash . data.title: Operations Specialist für Gutachten & Online-Auktionen (m/w/d)
data.description: Das sind wir Die HT Hanseatische Industrie-Consult gehört zu den führenden Unternehmen für die Bewertung und Verwertung von Maschinen, Anlagen und weiterem mobilen Betriebsvermögen in Deutschland. Wir erstellen fundierte Wertgutachten und begleiten Verwertungsprojekte von der ersten Aufnahme bis zum erfolgreichen Verkauf. Wir selbst bezeichnen uns als Industrieauktionshaus und sind Generalisten in einem speziellen Umfeld. Was dich im Alltag erwartet Als Projektassistenz (wie wir die Position intern nennen) begleitest du unsere Gutachten und Online-Auktionen operativ von der Vorbereitung bis zum Abschluss. Dabei sorgst du dafür, dass Informationen vollständig vorliegen, Termine und Abläufe koordiniert werden und alle Beteiligten zuverlässig zusammenarbeiten. Du unterstützt die Projektmanager bei der Gutachtenerstellung und übernimmst gleichzeitig zentrale Aufgaben in der Auktionsabwicklung. So bist du eine wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen Projektmanagement, Verkäufern, Käufern und unserem Back-Office und stellst sicher, dass offene Themen strukturiert und termingerecht zum Abschluss gebracht werden. Deine Aufgaben Erstellung von Gutachten in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Projektmanager Operative Steuerung von Auktionen von der Vorbereitung bis zum Abschluss Erstellung und Prüfung von Projekten, Agreements, Uploads und Auktionsdaten Betreuung von Verkäufern und Bearbeitung auktionsbezogener Anfragen von Bietern Koordination von Besichtigungen, Abholungen und offenen Vorgängen Nachverfolgung von Auktionsergebnissen und Unterstützung bei Nachverkäufen Vorbereitung und Abwicklung von Verkäuferabrechnungen und Auszahlungen Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Back-Office von HT und weiteren internen und externen Teams Worauf es in dieser Rolle ankommt Gesucht wird jemand, der auch bei vielen parallelen Vorgängen strukturiert bleibt, offene Themen konsequent nachhält und gerne Verantwortung für einen vollständigen Prozess übernimmt. Was du mitbringen solltest: Erfahrung in der operativen Steuerung von Prozessen oder einer kundenorientierten Operations-Funktion Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Systemen und eine sorgfältige Datenpflege Erfahrung in der Koordination verschiedener interner und externer Ansprechpartner Verständnis für Prozessqualität, Fristen und zuverlässige Nachverfolgung Eigenständige, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise Verantwortungsbewusstsein und hohe Zuverlässigkeit Serviceorientierte und professionelle Kommunikation mit Verkäufern und Bietern Lösungsorientierte, pragmatische Arbeitsweise und Freude an Zusammenarbeit Was wir dir bieten Verantwortung für den gesamten Prozess Von der Gutachtenerstellung und den Vorbereitungen einer Auktion bis zur finalen Auszahlung begleitest du den vollständigen operativen Ablauf und übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle im Tagesgeschäft. Struktur und Gestaltungsspielraum Klare Prozesse geben Orientierung. Gleichzeitig kannst du Verbesserungspotenziale erkennen und dazu beitragen, unsere Abläufe weiterzuentwickeln. Zusammenarbeit statt Einzelkämpfertum Du arbeitest eng mit den Projektmanagern und dem Back-Office und weiteren externen Mitarbeitern zusammen und kannst dich auf erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Hintergrund verlassen. data.title: Softwaretester:in (m/w/d)
data.description: sovero GmbH, ein renommiertes Unternehmen in der Technologie- und Informationsbranche mit Sitz in Frankfurt am Main, sucht Softwaretester:in (m/w/d) in Vollzeit zur Verstärkung unseres Teams. Mit unseren engagierten Mitarbeitenden entwickeln wir erfolgreich Softwarelösungen für die digitale Verwaltung von Dokumenten sowie deren Bearbeitung mittels Workflow-Prozessen. Moderne Projektfelder verbinden wir mit fast 50 Jahren Erfahrung und einem zukunftssicheren Firmenhintergrund. Aufgaben Unsere Mission ist nicht weniger als die vollständige Umstellung der Verwaltungen auf digitale Geschäftsprozesse. Dafür brauchen wir Menschen, die Freude an Innovationen haben. Als Softwaretester:in leistest Du einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur Qualität unserer Lösungen: Mit Deinem Blick fürs Detail und Deinem Qualitätsanspruch stellst Du sicher, dass die gemeinsam im Team entwickelte Software zuverlässig und fehlerfrei bei unseren tausenden Anwendern ankommt. EIN SPANNENDES AUFGABENFELD In dieser Rolle des/der Softwaretesters:in bist Du Teil unserer Qualitätssicherung und übernimmst eine zentrale Aufgabe bei der Sicherstellung der Softwarequalität. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf dem manuellen Testen: Du führst bestehende Testszenarien durch, entwickelst neue Testfälle und passt diese kontinuierlich an neue Anforderungen an. Dabei sorgst Du für eine strukturierte und nachvollziehbare Testabdeckung unserer Anwendungen. Ein Teil Deines Aufgabenbereichs ist die enge Mitarbeit in einem agilen Scrum-Team. Dort begleitest Du die Entwicklung neuer Features aus Testsicht, überprüfst implementierte Funktionalitäten und leitest eigenständig Testfälle aus User Stories und fachlichen Anforderungen ab. Im Rahmen des Test-Driven Development (TDD) wirkst Du außerdem daran mit, frühzeitig passende Testszenarien zu definieren und zu etablieren. Darüber hinaus arbeitest Du aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung unserer QS-Prozesse mit. Perspektivisch besteht die Möglichkeit, Dich im Bereich der Testautomatisierung weiterzuentwickeln, insbesondere im Umfeld von UI-Tests. Qualifikation DAS ERWARTEN WIR VON DIR Erste Erfahrung im Software Testing, idealerweise im manuellen Testen Fähigkeit, Testszenarien und Testfälle eigenständig aus User Stories und Anforderungen abzuleiten und zu erstellen Strukturierte Vorgehensweise bei der Durchführung und Dokumentation von Tests Verständnis für Softwareentwicklungsprozesse, idealerweise im agilen Umfeld (Scrum) Teamfähigkeit sowie eine sorgfältige und analytische Arbeitsweise Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Von Vorteil sind außerdem: Kenntnisse in der Testautomatisierung, insbesondere im Bereich UI-Tests (z. B. data.title: Cybersecurity Project Manager (m/w/d)
data.description: Who are we? It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks. This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents. All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS! What will you do? As Cybersecurity Project Manager (m/w/d) based in Germany , you will lead the delivery of projects that help protect organisations and the people who depend on them across Europe. You will bring together NVISO specialists in security operations, automation, Detection Engineering, Cybersecurity Architecture and incident response to turn customer ambitions into delivered security solutions. You will manage implementation, integration and improvement projects from kick-off through acceptance and handover to the teams responsible for ongoing operations. You will keep scope, timelines and dependencies aligned, and make sure customers and colleagues know what has been agreed, what comes next and where a decision is needed. You will work closely with Business Development, senior management and technical experts, organising their contributions and following commitments through. Your cybersecurity knowledge will help you ask informed questions and connect technical dependencies to delivery decisions. Experts retain technical ownership; you bring the people, plans and decisions together to deliver the project. Typical responsibilities include: · Managing implementation projects from kick-off to acceptance, with clear scope, milestones, dependencies and responsibilities across NVISO teams and customer stakeholders; · Securing commitments from capability leads and organising timely support and decisions from Business Development, senior management and technical experts; · Leading customer meetings and delivery reporting, aligning expectations and communicating progress, risks and next steps in language suited to each audience; · Managing risks, issues and scope changes, agreeing achievable plans and escalating decisions with clear options and their impact on delivery; · Tracking effort, budget consumption and forecast-to-complete, and reporting deviations and proposed actions to the senior manager, who retains P&L ownership; · Coordinating expert validation, customer acceptance and operational handover, then closing the project with follow-up actions assigned and lessons captured. What we are looking for You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states or the Austrian citizenship; Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent professional experience; Experience managing multi-team cybersecurity or IT implementation projects, covering planning, dependencies, risks, scope changes and delivery reporting; Sound understanding of security operations, detection and response, automation and cybersecurity architecture, sufficient to discuss dependencies with experts and explain their delivery implications; Experience tracking effort, budgets and forecasts, and coordinating contributors and decisions across several teams without direct line-management authority; Experience in consulting or customer-facing delivery is an advantage; a project management qualification such as PMP or PRINCE2 is welcome; Fluent business English and professional fluency in German (at least C1-level). Your benefits At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components: Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc); Generous training budget of 10.000 EUR + 10 man days for attending lectures rolling over 2 years; Base salary range (depending on experience and skillset): 70.000 EUR p.a. – 100.000 EUR p.a.; Regular team-building and fun events; Our commitment to coach and counsel you and help you grow; each employee receives a personal coach within the team, whose role is to ensure your well-being and helps you grow in your career! Flexible working hours and home office possibilities (incl. working abroad weeks within the EU); Business Bike Leasing; BahnCard 50 1st class + public transfer ticket or EGYM WellPass; 30 holidays; Company Pension Scheme; Cool offices in the center of Frankfurt, Munich and Vienna (with BBQ, kicker table, table tennis, playstations, etc.). data.title: Implementation Engineer
data.description: We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam. Client Engineering is the technical arm of Plaid’s European GTM team. We own our customers’ technical outcomes: designing the right solution, getting it built and live, and keeping it healthy as they grow. We work with the most technically forward companies in European financial services – fintechs, lenders, and payments and wealth platforms – helping them build on payment initiation, account data, verification, and underwriting across UK Open Banking and PSD2. As an Implementation Engineer for Plaid Europe, you’ll own customer integrations from the moment a contract is signed to the moment they’re live in production and growing. You’ll write the integration plan, run the kickoff, debug alongside the customer’s engineers, validate their sandbox implementation, and see them through go-live, keeping their Account Manager up to date with notes that make the relationship easy to continue. You’ll do the same for existing customers adding a new product, use case, or market. Responsibilities Own a portfolio of customer integrations from signature to production launch, including plans, milestones, and exit criteria. Run scheduled implementation support for standard integrations, as well as one-off debugging engagements for customers who need a targeted fix. Lead technical onboarding for existing customers adopting a new Plaid product, use case, or market. Debug integration issues hands-on with customer engineers across API, SDK, OAuth redirect, and webhook behaviour. Validate sandbox implementations and run go-live readiness checks. Use Plaid’s own data to proactively diagnose integration and conversion problems. Produce written handovers to Account Management and maintain the team’s reusable implementation resources. Escalate recurring integration failures to Product and Engineering as clear patterns, backed by evidence. Qualifications 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role, such as implementation, integration, solutions, or technical account management, ideally at an API platform. Hands-on experience with REST APIs, OAuth, webhooks, JSON, and web and mobile SDKs. Comfort working in Postman or curl and reading API documentation critically. Experience with SQL or other data querying tools. A track record of owning technical projects end to end, with real deadlines and direct relationships with customer engineers. Clear written communication skills, including plans, handovers, and customer updates. Comfort working independently in a small regional team alongside a globally distributed function. Nice-to-Haves Knowledge of open banking, including UK Open Banking, PSD2/PSD3, AIS/PIS, and VRP. Domain depth in payments, identity verification, or credit and underwriting. A formal technical background or prior software engineering experience. Experience with mobile integrations. Fluency in a second European language. data.title: Senior HW Engineer – PCB Layout
data.description: The Opportunity Lumai's optical engine only works if the electronics around it hold up. Our boards carry large FPGAs and custom ASICs, multi-gigabit links and fine-pitch packages, and they have to be laid out to tolerances that leave no room for guesswork. This role takes the designs coming out of our hardware and SI/PI teams and turns them into manufacturable, high-layer-count boards. The Role You will own board layout from schematic handoff to fabrication release. That covers stackups and HDI structures, controlled-impedance routing, differential pairs, length and phase matching, BGA breakout for large fine-pitch devices, and the full manufacturing package: Gerber/ODB++, drill files, assembly drawings and fabrication notes. You will also own the footprint and symbol libraries, the design rules and the CAD standards the rest of the team works to. What is genuinely hard about it is that the constraints are real and they conflict. Signal integrity, power integrity, thermal and mechanical requirements all land on the same square centimetres, and the fabricator's process limits decide what is actually buildable. You will be the person who turns simulation output into layout rules and who can defend a stackup to a fabricator. By month six, you will have taken at least one board through to fabrication release, set the libraries and design rules the team works from, and be the first point of contact for our fabricators and assembly houses. What You'll Do Lay out dense, high-layer-count PCBs from schematic through to fabrication release, using constraint-driven flows. Implement controlled-impedance routing, differential pair and length/phase matching, and HDI structures including microvias, via-in-pad and back-drilling. Plan BGA breakout and component placement for large FPGAs, custom ASICs and fine-pitch packages, balancing SI, PI, thermal and mechanical requirements. Translate SI/PI and hardware constraints into layout rules, and iterate quickly with engineers on simulation feedback. Run DFM, DFA and DFT reviews, and act as the main technical contact with PCB fabricators and assembly houses. Generate complete manufacturing outputs (Gerber/ODB++, drill files, assembly drawings, fabrication notes) and manage design revisions. Own and maintain the footprint and symbol libraries, CAD standards and design templates, compliant with IPC standards. What We're Looking For Must-have Extensive professional experience laying out complex, high-speed, high-layer-count boards, with a portfolio of designs that went into production. Expert proficiency in Cadence Allegro, including Constraint Manager. Equivalent Altium experience will also be considered. Hands-on experience with HDI technologies: microvias, via-in-pad, stacked and staggered vias, and back-drilling. Proven BGA breakout and placement for large, fine-pitch devices such as FPGAs and ASICs. Thorough working knowledge of IPC standards (IPC-2221, IPC-7351, IPC-6012) and of DFM/DFA/DFT principles. Strong preference for Boards carrying 56G+ SerDes, PCIe Gen5/6 or DDR5 interfaces. Working closely with SI/PI simulation engineers. Rigid-flex, RF or mixed-signal layouts. ECAD/MCAD collaboration on thermal and mechanical integration. Experience setting up CAD standards, libraries and design templates in a growing team. About Lumai Lumai is the optical compute company building the next generation of AI infrastructure. Spun out of optics research at the University of Oxford in 2021, we compute with light instead of electrons. Our 3D optical technology carries out the matrix multiplications at the heart of AI inside beams of light travelling through free space, which lets it go beyond the limits of both silicon GPUs and integrated photonics. In April 2026 we launched Iris Nova, the world's first optical computing system to run billion-parameter large language models in real time, using up to 90% less energy than conventional GPU-based systems. Iris Nova, the first server in the family, is now available for evaluation by hyperscalers, neoclouds, enterprises and research institutions. Aura and Tetra will follow. Our work won the Falling Walls Award for Science Breakthrough of the Year 2025 and 'Best Overall Technology' at the OCP Future Technologies Symposium. We are headquartered in Oxford. Why Lumai You'll work on a new kind of computer. Optical computing for AI has been promised for decades. We have a working system running real models, and the hard part left is taking it to volume. Your work ships. We are moving from first product to volume production, so what you build this year goes into the servers our customers run. You'll work across disciplines. Optical engineers, machine learning researchers, and hardware and software engineers solve problems together. You will learn things that don't appear on your job description. The work matters beyond Lumai. AI's appetite for energy is one of the defining constraints of the next decade. Our mission is sustainable intelligence at global scale: AI that is faster, cheaper to run and far less power-hungry. You'll join early. You'll have a real say in how we build the product, the team and the way we work. Equal Opportunity Lumai is an equal opportunity employer. data.title: Enterprise Account Executive
data.description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $14M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY. The Role: We are looking for Enterprise Account Executives. This role is focused on selling into global enterprises with distributed teams, multiple buying centres, layered governance, and high data sensitivity. These are strategic accounts where the impact of accurate hierarchies and clean CRM data is measured in millions. Our first ramped AEs are far exceeding quota, so we know the motion works. Our early enterprise motion is working. We are generating strong demand and building pipeline within large organisations. You will be responsible for driving high six-figure opportunities and are confident that we will close the first 7 figure deals this year through complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. Our targets call for millions of additional ARR over the next year. You will play a major role in that. Important to Know: Hours - This will be an exciting but intense job. Kernel is growing extremely fast and hours can often be long. Many of our customers are on the West Coast, and meetings can be held late in the evening. Working location - Minimum 4 days a week in the London office (most people do 5). There will be international travel involved for this role in visiting prospects. Responsibilities: You’ll manage complex sales cycles with some of the best Enterprise businesses out there (5,000+ employees), from mid six-figure through to seven-figure+ deals. Multi-thread within accounts and build executive-level relationships, including VP and C-level stakeholders. Most opportunities will be sourced for you by the SDR team and Growth team, however sourcing additional pipeline is expected. You’ll collaborate with the wider team on GTM strategy as we expand our ICP & experiment in other verticals. You’ll help to create our sales processes as you build them. You’ll become the best person in the company at explaining & pitching the product. You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and customer success, bringing in insights from across the company and performing an essential part of our product feedback loop. Your Traits: Entrepreneurial: creative, resourceful. Executive presence: You are comfortable engaging VPs, CROs, CIOs, and senior RevOps leaders. All-in: hard-working, excited to stretch yourself, willing to take out the trash. Clear thinker, good writer: you can crisply articulate your ideas, goals, and plans and help our customers make sense of hairy consulting-like problems. Essential Qualifications: 3-7 years of experience. At least 1 year consistently closing deals worth $50k+/year in a multi-stakeholder sales process, consistently hitting six- to seven-figure targets. Ability to execute on a consultative, solutions-oriented, value-based selling methodology (MEDDPICC). Track record of consistent over-achievement in past sales roles. Ability to discuss technical concepts with prospective customers and translate requirements into a demonstrable product. Comfort negotiating and navigating contracts, security and legal discussions without support. Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal skills. Nice-To-Have: Startup/scale-up experience is a plus. Experience selling to Revenue Operations, GTM and/or Sales teams. Familiarity with Salesforce. What We Offer We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling. 💰 Salary: £140k-£200k OTE + equity 🗓️ 24 days holiday per year + bank holidays 🥕 £450 Monthly Office Dinner Allowance ✈️ 2 weeks work-from-anywhere 🍼 Generous parental leave policy 💼 Pension plan 💻 Top-spec equipment and central London office 🎉 Team events and dinners 🚀 Work directly with the founders to scale the systems that power enterprise AI 🏆 High-autonomy, high-trust environment with a small team shipping at pace Interview Process Stage 1 – 30-minute intro call with Talent Partner. You’ll discuss your sales experience and motivations. Stage 2 – 1-hour interview with Head of Sales. You’ll deep dive into your experience, sales targets & achievements, and Enterprise AE at Kernel. Stage 3 – Discovery role play (≤ 2 hours prep). Final Stage – Founders interview with Anders (CEO) for culture and values alignment. If there is mutual fit, we move to references and offer. Each added capability makes the others stronger. Agents monitor obligations, populate returns, catch anomalies and assemble audit packs in seconds. The system does the work. Humans make the calls. That’s autonomous tax. We operate across 120+ countries, with clients going live in weeks, if not days. Trusted by Canva, Netflix, Spotify, Uber, Zoom and Booking.com . Rated 4.5/5 stars and a High Performer on G2 and 4.6/5 stars on Gartner Peer Insights. You'll set the strategy for how Fonoa ranks and wins in search across VAT, GST, e-invoicing, and every indirect tax topic our buyers are researching, then make sure that strategy actually ships: technical SEO health, on-page implementation, and a content pipeline that turns deep tax subject matter into pages that rank and convert. You'll work closely with our tax subject matter experts to keep every piece of content accurate and credible, and with marketing ops to keep the site technically sound. What You'll Own Organic strategy . Partner with Fonoa's tax subject matter experts to source accurate, defensible claims for every piece of content. Own the review loop that keeps technical accuracy high without slowing production to a crawl. Performance and reporting. Track rankings, organic traffic, and conversion from organic content. Report on what's working, what isn't, and where to double down. Editorial standards. Who We're Looking For: 3–6 years of SEO experience, ideally with both a strategy/content background and hands-on technical SEO chops (not purely one or the other). A strong, precise writer and editor with sharp judgment on what "good" looks like, not just what a checklist says. Comfortable owning a roadmap independently and prioritizing across strategy, technical fixes, and content production at the same time. Bonus: experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, or another vertical with technical/regulatory subject matter. data.description: About Ema Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance.
