data.title: Dessinateur Projeteur CAO
data.description: About Alta Ares Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them. Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development. Au sein de l'équipe technique, vous concevez en CAO les pièces et sous-ensembles mécaniques de nos produits, dans nos drones et leurs équipements embarqués. Votre quotidien est la modélisation sous Fusion 360 et Solidworks : mécanismes et pièces imprimés en 3D, intégration des composants électroniques, assemblages complets. Vous faites évoluer rapidement les designs à partir des impressions et des essais, et vous produisez les plans, nomenclatures et documents de montage des versions validées. Missions principales Conception CAO (cœur de métier : 70 %) Concevoir et modéliser sous Fusion 360 et Solidworks des pièces et sous-ensembles : structures, carters, supports, fixations, interfaces Concevoir des mécanismes imprimés en 3D : charnières, verrouillages, clips, pièces mobiles Intégrer les composants électroniques dans la CAO : implantation des cartes, moteurs, ESC, batteries et capteurs, passage des câbles, refroidissement, accessibilité pour la maintenance Appliquer les règles de conception FDM et autres procédés : orientation, épaisseurs, jeux et tolérances d'assemblage, inserts, limitation des supports Structurer les assemblages (paramétrage, composants réutilisables) pour faciliter les évolutions Assurer la gestion des versions des fichiers CAO Réaliser des conceptions paramétriques et modifiables Prototypage rapide (15 %) Enchaîner des cycles courts conception → impression 3D → test → correction Préparer les impressions sous OrcaSlicer et assembler les prototypes Faire évoluer les designs à partir des retours d'impression et d'essais Plans et documentation de production (10 %) Réaliser les mises en plan et les nomenclatures des pièces et sous-ensembles validés Participer à la rédaction des gammes de montage et des instructions d'assemblage Participer aux modifications des schémas de câblage Essais (5 %) Participer aux essais de validation : banc, sol et, le cas échéant, essais en vol encadrés Présenter régulièrement l'avancement à l'équipe technique Profil recherché Formation et expérience Bac+2/+3 (BTS CPRP ou CPI, BUT GMP, licence pro) en conception mécanique, génie mécanique ou mécatronique Compétences techniques Bonne maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO 3D, idéalement Autodesk Fusion et SolidWorks (CATIA ou d'autres) Conception de mécanismes et d'assemblages Règles de conception pour l'impression 3D FDM ; pratique d'OrcaSlicer ou d'un autre slicer Mise en plan, cotation et tolérancement Bases en électronique embarquée : lecture de schémas, câblage, soudure Atouts Connaissance du monde des drones (multirotors, voilure fixe, ArduPilot / PX4) Notions d'aérodynamique (portance, traînée, profils, hélices) Projets personnels ou associatifs en drone, robotique ou impression 3D (portfolio CAO apprécié) Intérêt pour l'aéronautique, le spatial ou la défense Qualités personnelles Goût pour le prototypage et le travail « hands-on » et la CAO "bien faite" Rigueur et sens du détail, indispensables dans un contexte défense où la fiabilité des pièces est critique Autonomie, force de proposition et esprit d'équipe Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

data.title: Software Engineer Intern - Financial Services
data.description: About Mirakl: Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy. Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus). With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways. For more information: www.mirakl.com . Mirakl in Numbers: 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions Our Values: Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique. Our 5 values guide how we collaborate: 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success 1. The Team You'll Join You'll be part of our Mirakl Labs Financial Services squad, based in Paris. The team is structured as a cross-functional Squad composed of a Senior Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, Software Engineers and a QA engineer. You'll be mentored by Wael Osmani, Software Engineer . You'll join a team that builds and ships the core product features powering some of the world's most ambitious marketplace platforms, with a particular focus on financial services capabilities. 2. Your Impact Contribute to the development and evolution of a production application, primarily on the frontend — from UI implementation to user experience improvements Support backend work by participating in API design and development, collaborating closely with the engineering team Work hand-in-hand with UX/UI designers to deliver features that are both technically solid and user-centric Take part in agile rituals — stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives — and contribute actively to the team's roadmap Monitor and take ownership of your contributions in production, following a you build it, you run it mindset 3. What You'll Bring to the Role Experience: Currently pursuing a Master's degree (M1 or M2) in software engineering, computer science, or a related field, and looking for a 6-month internship First hands-on development experience through an internship, academic project, apprenticeship, or personal project Solid understanding of frontend development and object-oriented programming principles Skills: Proficiency or strong interest in frontend frameworks such as React or Angular , and in JavaScript/TypeScript Familiarity with Java for backend and API development Curiosity for clean code, software quality, and working on production-grade applications A collaborative mindset, intellectual curiosity, and a genuine drive to learn 4. Tech Stack Back-end: Java 21, Spring Boot Front-end: ReactJS Data & Messaging: Kafka, ElasticSearch, PostgreSQL Tooling & Practices: CI/CD, Git, Docker, Monitoring 5. Languages French: Fluent English: Professional proficiency (written and spoken) Compensation, Perks & Benefits Pay Range: €1,200 – €1,400 per month Our Hiring Process We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match. Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible. Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter , then an AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma , Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador, to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application. Recruiter interview (30 min) — conversation about your background, motivations, and an introduction to Mirakl Hiring Manager interview (45 min) — technical discussion covering Java and web development fundamentals, including practical exercises STAR interview (1h) — exchange with one or two team members exploring Mirakl's values and culture We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations. As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. data.title: Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights
data.description: We are growing! We are currently looking to hire a Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights . About CXG: Founded in 2006, CXG is a global customer experience company uniquely positioned at the intersection of data-driven retail performance, customer experience transformation, and operational execution across 200+ luxury brands worldwide. The mission of our 270 collaborators is to help brands transform customer and employee experiences through tailored insights, strategy, and implementation. We are passionate about delivering impact. Our clients include the world's most admired luxury houses, and our solutions combine research, technology, and human expertise to elevate every customer interaction. We are looking for a thought leadership expert with the editorial vision to spot what matters next, the conviction to shape CXG's point of view, and the writing talent to make it influential across luxury retail, beauty and cosmetics, watches and jewellery, automotive, and hospitality. Context and role Reporting to the Chief of Staff, you will lead CXG's Thought Leadership and Market Intelligence functions. You will define the topics on which CXG should have a distinctive and credible point of view, turn CXG's proprietary data, expertise and market knowledge into original external content, and position the company ahead of emerging developments in customer experience, luxury and its priority verticals. This is a hands-on role: you will research, analyse, write and produce content yourself, while mobilising expertise and data from across the business. You will be accountable for ensuring that every publication presents a recognisable CXG angle rather than simply reporting market developments or repeating established industry views. You will manage one Market Intelligence team member. Thought Leadership Development Define the thought leadership strategy and roadmap, including priority themes, target audiences, formats and a realistic publication calendar. Drive and coordinate content creation across Practices, Solutions and Regions. Work closely with Practices, Regions and Solutions to: Push: scan for trends and hot topics and ensure CXG has a voice and perspective, commenting regularly on these subjects. Pull: identify and collect new ideas and proposed topics from the relevant stakeholders, prioritise and incorporate them into the thought leadership roadmap. Use market intelligence, CXG's proprietary data, internal expertise and client-facing insights to identify emerging topics early, develop a clear CXG point of view and decide where CXG can make a credible contribution to the conversation. Research, interview internal experts, write and edit articles, perspectives and other thought leadership content directly. Challenge generic claims and ensure each piece advances a clear argument and is supported by credible evidence. Ensure that analysis is methodologically sound, appropriately contextualised and presented without compromising client confidentiality. Develop topics that connect expertise across Practices and Regions, while reflecting relevant differences between markets. Thought Leadership Communication Ensure relevant thought leadership pieces (e.g., perspectives, publications) are disseminated on a periodic basis. Work with Marketing on the publication, distribution and promotion of content, while retaining ownership of the editorial strategy, substance, quality and consistency of CXG's point of view. In addition, collaborate with Marketing to maximise impact by communicating through the channels relevant to each market. Track the reach, engagement and qualitative response generated by CXG's thought leadership, as well as relevant business enquiries influenced by published content. Use the findings to refine the roadmap. Shape and host or contribute to CXG's podcast "The Luxury Edit", working with internal experts and guests to develop topics, prepare interviews and turn conversations into useful content. Develop the content and key messages for CXG-hosted events and external conferences, panels and talks; act as a CXG speaker where appropriate; and work with internal experts to prepare other CXG speakers and turn the company's point of view into compelling presentations and discussion topics. Look for and test new thought leadership formats (e.g., interactive reports, data visualisations, short-form video, newsletters, social-first content) to broaden reach, engage new audiences and keep CXG's content distinctive. Identify and build collaborations with conferences, specialised industry magazines and universities (e.g., content partnerships, guest articles, co-branded publications, joint research, guest lectures, speaking slots) to extend CXG's visibility and credibility with target audiences. Market Intelligence Keep abreast of market and competitive developments and ensure relevant findings are communicated across CXG. Translate these findings into clear implications for CXG's strategic priorities, client conversations, commercial opportunities and external thought leadership. Contribute market intelligence, evidence and relevant CXG perspectives to priority proposals and client deliverables, working with Practices, Solutions and Regions to strengthen the quality and relevance of the final output. Manage and develop the Market Intelligence team member, setting clear priorities and reviewing the quality and usefulness of their work. Competitive Analysis Develop and continuously update a list of CXG competitors. Research competitor performance, including revenues and market share where reliable information is available. Identify and assess the impact of new competitors' offerings. Review competitors' thought leadership, influence and presence. Identify gaps in the conversations competitors are leading and opportunities for CXG to establish a distinct position. Industry Analysis Research and review clients' developments (e.g., new strategy, launch of new product or service, restructuring, M&A, key managerial appointments). Track public financial announcements (e.g., quarterly and annual earnings). Monitor developments in luxury, retail, customer experience and adjacent sectors; distinguish lasting shifts from short-lived topics and explain their implications for CXG and its clients. Publish the weekly "This Week in Luxury" news brief and issue timely flash updates when significant developments require immediate attention, such as financial announcements, major transactions or leadership changes. Internal Dissemination and Application Synthesise research and findings into concise, actionable outputs tailored to the needs of relevant internal stakeholders. Feed findings into the Thought Leadership roadmap. Proactively bring relevant market signals to Practices, Regions and leadership early enough to inform decisions, client conversations and potential cross-practice opportunities. Disseminate new thought leadership across CXG and equip Practices, Regions and client-facing teams with the key messages and supporting materials needed to use it in client conversations and commercial activities. Requirements What will you bring along? Proven experience developing thought leadership, editorial content or insight-led communications in a consulting, research, customer experience, retail or luxury environment. Excellent English writing and editing skills, with a portfolio demonstrating original, well-argued, evidence-led articles or publications written personally. If possible, include examples that turn proprietary research, data or specialist expertise into a distinctive point of view. Additional languages (e.g., French, Mandarin) are a plus. Strong oral communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to represent CXG as a speaker at conferences, panels and client events. Proven ability to build relationships and influence senior stakeholders across functions and regions without direct authority. An established network or demonstrated ability to build partnerships with media, conference organisers, academic institutions or industry bodies. Comfort working with quantitative data and research methods, and the ability to translate data into clear, credible narratives and visualisations. Ability to define and track content performance indicators and use them to refine editorial priorities. Strong research and analytical skills: able to assess sources critically, connect market signals and form a clear point of view rather than simply summarise trends. Familiarity with AI-assisted research and content tools, used with appropriate rigour. Sound knowledge of luxury, retail and customer experience, and curiosity about how these sectors are evolving across markets. Ability to interview senior experts, challenge ideas constructively and turn specialist knowledge into accessible, credible content. Comfort working independently in a remote setting, managing an editorial roadmap and delivering finished work without a large production team. Experience managing or coaching at least one team member. Confidence preparing and hosting interviews or podcasts is a plus. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

data.title: Strategic Account Executive (France)
data.description: Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey. We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses. We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey. We're designing the future of autonomous marketing , taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do. And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora. As a Strategic Account Executive at Bloomreach, you will lead new-business sales in multi-stakeholder environments and manage end-to-end, complex deal cycles. You’ll own the full sales cycle—from prospecting and qualification through pricing, negotiation, and close—delivering new revenue across the French market. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with SDRs, Solutions Consultants, and key internal teams, as well as external partners, to open, advance, and win strategic opportunities. Your work will be pivotal in driving our growth in the region. Key Responsibilities: Develop and execute a targeted cross-regional sales strategy to penetrate key prospects (C-level), acquire new logos, and drive revenue growth Act as the CEO of your territory by assembling and leading a cross-functional virtual team to execute go-to-market strategies, including entering new markets or developing green markets when required. Hand over the deals to the Account Management to ensure a seamless customer experience Qualify leads early and effectively by identifying pain points and matching personas to Bloomreach’s Ideal Customer Profile (ICP). Demonstrate strong proficiency in sales methodologies such as Value-Based Selling, MEDDPICC, or Challenger Sales to navigate complex sales cycles and drive high-value deals. Ensure a robust sales pipeline by maintaining 3x the quarterly target through active prospecting and engaging effectively with C-level clients via various channels, including cold-calls, marketing lead follow-ups, RFPs, professional relationships, local marketing agency contacts, webinars, networking and face-to-face meetings. Collaborate closely with your CEA, channel partner, marketing, enablement, product and customer success teams, to revive old or stalled opportunities, qualify opportunities, and actively mature opportunities consistently Conduct thorough business needs analyses, prepare high-level client briefs, demos, and proposals presenting the unique value proposition of Bloomreach, and explain how it satisfies their needs. Clearly articulate how Bloomreach provides value over competitors and ensures shortlisting for purchasing decisions. Understand the Request for Proposal (RFP) process and influence it early on. Manage the CRM system to ensure accurate reporting and forecasting, maintaining high standards of data hygiene. Multithread to build and maintain solid long-term client relationships with key decision-makers and influencers, offering regular follow-ups and checking in on evolving needs. Provide insights on market trends, competitive landscape, and customer feedback to improve our product and sales effectiveness. Demonstrate initiative in your role to grow the business. Consistently achieve and exceed new business revenue targets. Act as a mentor or "buddy" for other regions, teams and junior team members. Follow instructions of the manager and complete additional duties as needed. What We’re Looking For: 5+ years years of quota-carrying experience (B2B sales) selling software or software-as-a-service (SaaS) Deep knowledge of MarTech technologies, CRM, Marketing Automation, CMS, Search and Merch or data capabilities A proven track record of meeting and exceeding revenue quota in a Sales Manager or equivalent role Well-established presence in the local markets with a relevant network The ability to successfully negotiate and close deals in a highly collaborative team environment Detail oriented, relationship-building skills, and a focus on a high level of customer service, having a passion for building rapport with clients and helping their businesses The ability to adapt to new environments and use your own initiative Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including high-calibre presentation skills Excellent time management skills, positive attitude and a “love of selling” Native French required #LI-SF1 More things you'll like about Bloomreach: Culture: A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one. We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication. We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style. We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents. We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead. We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*. The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5 Personal Development: We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions. Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.* Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins. Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)* Well-being: The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.* Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.* We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones. We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other. Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.* Compensation: Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.* Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.* We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000! We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!* (*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.) Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences! If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful! Si l’équipe rassemble deux expertises, ce poste aura une majeure en Affaires Publiques. Vos missions Affaires publiques : Superviser la veille institutionnelle, législative et réglementaire ; identifier et mobiliser les parties prenantes clés ; élaborer des argumentaires stratégiques (position papers, amendements) ; concevoir et piloter des actions de lobbying et d'influence. Création de contenus & excellence rédactionnelle : Production de contenus à haute valeur ajoutée (tribunes, communiqués de presse stratégiques, prises de parole de dirigeants, livres blancs, mémoires institutionnels) et garantir l'excellence rédactionnelle de l'équipe. Communication de crise : Concevoir et piloter les stratégies de gestion et communication de crise ; analyser et cartographier les risques ; superviser les dispositifs de veille médias et réseaux sociaux pour analyser les tendances et signaux faibles, traduire les opportunités/menaces en recommandations stratégiques directement exploitables par nos clients et rédiger des messages clés et éléments de langage adaptés. Pilotage de comptes, management & new business : Assurer le suivi opérationnel et financier des projets (gestion des budgets, rentabilité), encadrer et faire monter en compétences les consultants juniors et alternants ; participer activement aux réflexions stratégiques de l’équipe/agence ; réponses aux appels d'offres et soutenances commercial. Formation : Formation Bac +5 (IEP / Sciences Po, Droit public / Affaires Publiques, CELSA, Grande École de Commerce). Expertise : Solides compétences en Affaires Publiques requises ; expériences en communication de crise et gestion de la réputation corporate appréciées. Posture conseil & analyse : Esprit d'analyse aiguisé, forte curiosité pour l'actualité et les enjeux de société, et capacité à transformer des problématiques complexes en recommandations concrètes et impactantes pour des dirigeants. Qualités rédactionnelles : Plume soignée et maîtrise des exigences de production de contenus stratégiques. data.title: Head of Security
data.description: About Morpho Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world. Why Morpho Exists Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here . Location: Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team). About the role: As Head of Security, you'll define and drive Morpho's security strategy across the entire organization - corporate IT, cloud and infrastructure, application, supply chain, identity, incident response, threat intelligence, and counterparty security - and you'll build the team and function to deliver it. This is a hands-on leadership role: in the early days you'll personally do the work while you hire, and you'll stay close enough to the technical detail to earn the trust of a deeply technical organization. You'll also be Morpho's credible security voice, internally to leadership, and externally to the integrators, institutions, and ecosystem partners who depend on us. You'll partner closely with Engineering on infrastructure and deployment integrity, and with our Integration team, which works with various partners across the Morpho ecosystem. Responsibilities: Own and continuously evolve Morpho's security strategy and roadmap across, cloud/infrastructure, application, supply-chain, identity, and operational security. Build and lead the security function - hire, grow, and develop the team, recruiting skillsets across security operations and application security. Oversight of the IT function Stay hands-on. Personally execute critical security work - threat modeling, architecture review, control implementation, and incident command - while the team scales. Set the governance architecture: a coherent security framework that ties tooling and controls together, rather than accumulating tools in isolation. Own incident response end to end - runbooks, incident command, severity and escalation structure, and market communication during an event. Build and run a counterparty security program for curators and partners - identity verification, screening, operational diligence, and bidirectional incident-coordination channels. Lead Morpho's certification strategy (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001), meeting both the spirit and the letter sustainably. Represent Morpho's security posture externally - to fintechs, financial institutions, and the broader ecosystem - and internally to executives. Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Protocol, and Integrations, driving security outcomes through both direct ownership and influence. What Success Looks Like: First 30 Days You've built a clear, independent picture of Morpho's posture, architecture, threat model, and in-flight work - and pressure-tested the existing strategy against it. You've met the team and established working relationships with the people who own the surfaces you'll most depend on. You understand the path-to-funds attack surface in depth and have an early, evidence-based view of the highest-severity risks and quick wins. You know exactly where incident-response readiness stands today. First 60 Days You've published a clearly prioritized security roadmap with clear sequencing, owners, and the rationale for what's deferred and aligned leadership behind it. You've defined the team build-out plan and opened the first hire. You're personally driving the top-severity gaps - identity and authentication enforcement, deployment guardrails, and a documented incident-response runbook among them. You've set the governance framework and the certification path in motion. First 90 Days Demonstrable progress closing the highest-priority gaps, with key controls enforced rather than optional. A documented incident-response capability that's been validated by at least one tabletop exercise. Hiring underway, and a clear operating rhythm established with Engineering, Protocol, and Integrations. Morpho's external security posture is taking shape - trust surface, counterparty security program, and ecosystem engagement - and you're recognized internally and externally as Morpho's credible security voice. Must-have Experience & Skills: 10+ years in security, several of them building or leading a security function, ideally at a crypto/web3, fintech, or financial-services company where security is core to the business. Strong grasp of the crypto/web3 threat model Proven experience building and growing a security team from a small base, recruiting across security operations and application/infrastructure security. Deep, hands-on technical expertise across cloud, infrastructure, CI/CD, supply-chain, identity, and application security - you do the work, not just direct it. Owned incident response end to end, including incident command and external communication. Sharp prioritization and the ability to galvanize action through hard and soft influence, including driving outcomes through teams you don't own. Exceptional, organized, responsive communication - credible to executives and to external audiences from fintechs to Fortune 500 institutions. Humble. Nice to Have: An established network and public profile in the security or crypto-security community, and comfort representing security work publicly (talks, writing, framework contribution). Offensive security depth, or experience standing up red/blue capabilities. Familiarity with institutional and regulatory expectations and threat-sharing networks (e.g. Crypto ISAC, TIBER-style frameworks). Taken an organization through certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or equivalent) Perks & Benefits We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning. Equal Opportunity We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

data.title: Finance Manager, Financial Control & Accounting
data.description: At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store. Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko. From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it. Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US. It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us! 💰 Our Finance team The Finance team ensures Joko's financial health and long-term success. We manage everything from financial planning and accounting to financing and cash management. We make sure every euro is put to its best use, working closely with all teams, we provide the insights and structure needed to scale efficiently. As we scale, we're splitting Finance into three specialized poles: FP&A , Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) , and Procurement . This role anchors Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) — the pole that keeps Joko's financial information accurate, timely, and audit-ready. You'll report directly to Quentin, our COO . ✨ Why this role is special Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) is a brand-new specialized pole at Joko — previously bundled into a single generalist Finance Manager role. You'll be the first person to own this scope end to end, with direct visibility to the COO and VP Finance with real influence over how the function is built as the company scales past 200 people across multiple geographies. You set the standards, not just follow them: as the pole's first hire, the processes, controls, and calendar you establish now become the backbone the rest of Finance builds on. A true partner in automation: you'll work hand-in-hand with a dedicated BizOps partner to automate what can be automated — this isn't a role where you're expected to grind through manual work alone. International scope from day one: France, the US, and future markets — you'll help build the multi-entity, multi-country accounting backbone as Joko expands. 🎯 What you will do As Finance Manager, Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) , your main mission is to own the reliability, timeliness, and completeness of Joko's financial information. Rather than doing the bookkeeping — we have an external accounting partner for that — you set the standards, drive the calendar, and hold your internal and external stakeholders accountable. Your responsibilities will include: Drive the closing calendar: own the monthly and annual closing calendar, holding our external accounting partner and auditors to a high standard; Own our legal reporting package: make sure the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement are always accurate and delivered on time; Oversee AP/AR end to end: keep invoicing, payment runs, and collections under control; Lead our international accounting build-out: as we open new entities and markets, including our IFRS consolidation framework; Own cash management: reconciliation, yield optimization, and day-to-day treasury; Be the main point of contact for our banking and accounting partners , and a key interface for auditors as we scale toward IPO readiness; Continuously strengthen and document our financial processes and controls , working hand-in-hand with a dedicated BizOps partner to automate what can be automated, making everything more robust and less error-prone as the company scales. 👀 Who we're looking for Experience: 4–8 years, with a strong foundation in accounting or audit (Big 4 or equivalent), ideally combined with in-house experience in a scale-up. Education: A master's degree from a top business school. A double degree in accounting (DCG/DSCG) is a plus. Financial rigor: Deep understanding of French GAAP and treasury fundamentals — you bring the same discipline to a closing cycle as you do to a cash position. International mindset: Excited to build a multi-entity, multi-country accounting backbone as we expand; IFRS exposure is a plus. Stakeholder management: You build trust with partners inside and outside Joko, and you're comfortable holding them accountable. Problem solving: You dig into the root cause and fix things. AI centricity: You use AI in your daily work today, and you're excited to help automate reporting and reconciliation as part of Joko's AI-first finance ambition. Languages: Fluent French and English. 💎 Our perks (Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only) At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through: Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget. Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year. On top of that, we offer plenty of perks: 💸 Top-market compensation 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent …and much more, check the full list here ! 🤝 Our hiring process Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams). Step 2 – Role-specific assessments For non-engineering roles : A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design). For engineering roles : A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool). Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers. ☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture. Compensation: €61.5K – €84K • €61.5K – €84K Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

data.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, ML Platform
data.description: The Senior Machine Learning Engineer, ML Platform is responsible for building, running, and evolving the ML monorepo used by the X-ray, CT, and MRI machine learning group at DeepHealth. The monorepo covers the full path from experimentation to product: dataset and sample definitions, training and evaluation code, experiment tracking, model export, and the inference servers that run in production. Everyone on the team contributes to the monorepo; this role is the single point of accountability for it. This hands-on role owns the architecture, tooling, and engineering standards of that codebase for a distributed team of about twenty machine learning engineers and scientists, working with model developers and software engineers to make the team’s work fast, better, and easier to audit. It also leads the team's agentic coding strategy, shaping how AI coding agents are used across the codebase. The role reports to the Leader of the ML for X-ray/CT/MRI group. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Own the architecture and roadmap of the ML Monorepo: Module boundaries, shared abstractions for datasets and samples, training and evaluation loops, configuration, and experiment tracking. Build and run the engineering tooling around the codebase: Continuous integration, testing, dependency management, containers, artifact and model registries, and GPU job scheduling on cloud (GCP) and HPC infrastructure. Own the path from trained checkpoint to deployable model: Model packaging, inference servers with enforced API contracts, reproducibility, and performance and memory budgets on target hardware. Define and enforce engineering standards (code review, testing, documentation) in a way that accelerates research rather than slowing it down. Ensure traceability of data, code, and model versions across experiments and releases. Investigate and resolve performance, reliability, and usability issues in the stack raised by the team and reduce their recurrence through shared tooling. Drive the team's agentic coding strategy: define how AI coding agents are used in the monorepo, set up the tooling, guardrails, and conventions that make them effective, and help colleagues adopt them. Review code, mentor colleagues on engineering practices, and communicate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly. PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time. Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience Master's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (required). 5+ years of software engineering experience, including a significant portion building infrastructure or tooling used by machine learning teams, such as an ML platform or a training framework (required). Strong Python skills and software engineering fundamentals: API design, testing, refactoring, and attention to developer experience (required). Solid PyTorch knowledge and practical experience with model training and profiling (required). Experience running ML workloads on a cloud platform, ideally GCP (Vertex AI, Artifact Registry, IAM, storage), and with containerization (required). Experience taking models to production: model packaging, inference serving, and performance and reliability constraints (required). Ability to work closely with researchers, translate recurring pain points into shared tooling, and push back constructively when needed (required). Ability to work autonomously in a distributed, multi-site team, with clear verbal and written communication in English (required). Medical imaging experience (DICOM, 3D volumes, large images) (preferred). HPC and Slurm experience (preferred). Contributions to open-source ML tooling (preferred). Quality Standards Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors. Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems. Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines. data.description: About Mirakl: Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways. For more information: www.mirakl.com . Mirakl in Numbers: 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions Our Values: Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique. Our 5 values guide how we collaborate: 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success About the job Lead the design, development, and adoption of AI systems within a strategic business domain. You will combine deep AI engineering expertise with product and business understanding to identify high-impact opportunities, define roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes. As the AI technical lead for your domain, you will drive architecture decisions, engineering excellence, and AI adoption across teams and stakeholders. Examples of domains include: Sales, GTM and Marketing or Finance & Legal This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week. Why Now, Why Mirakl Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis. At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption. We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to transform cutting-edge AI technologies into reliable, scalable, and measurable products used by leading enterprises worldwide. You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it. What You'll Do 1. Own Tech Strategy for Your Domain Identify high-value opportunities with Business leaders Define the Tech vision and own the agent product roadmap for your domain 2. Lead AI System Development Design and build production-grade AI systems Drive architecture decisions Ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability 3. Drive Adoption & Business Impact Work closely with end users Measure adoption and outcomes Accelerate AI transformation across your domain 4. Establish Technical Excellence Promote best practices for evaluation, testing, guardrails, and observability Review designs and mentor engineers Raise the quality bar across initiatives 5. Grow AI Capability Mentor AI Engineers and Agent Builders Share knowledge and reusable components Build AI expertise within your organization Success Metrics Business impact delivered by AI initiatives Adoption within the domain Technical quality and reliability Team capability growth Our stack and tools Languages: Python and SQL AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes You'll Love This Job If you have 7+ years in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, or Applied AI Strong experience with LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, evaluation, and production systems Ability to influence Product and Business decisions Proven leadership on complex cross-functional initiatives Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on! data.title: Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e)
data.description: Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées À propos de l'opportunité Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l'aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants. En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d'opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route. Vous devrez justifier d'une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp. Vos missions Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes. Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp. Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels. Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat. Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp. Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits. Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain. Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes. Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux. Ce que nous recherchons Indispensable Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons. Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects. Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs. Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu. La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections. Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux. La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer. Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients. La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients. Atouts Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp. Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente. Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain. Rémunération Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés. Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner : Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions. Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème. Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème. Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans. Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois. Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales. Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d'activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s'appliquer. Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables. Formation et accompagnement Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l'accompagnement des clients. Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage. Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d'analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d'organisation. data.description: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The position of the Senior Value Engineer is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements. The Role: You are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Teams and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide. The work you’ll do: Identify & Frame Value Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executive Realize Value Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives Scale Value Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases The qualifications you need: Live for Customer Value: Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise. Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP), experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of Python and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams. Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures, being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value Project Management: Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible. Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Business Domain Expertise: Understanding of the Finance and/or Supply Chain domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation) Industry Expertise: Ideally expertise in Aviation/Logistics/Transportation and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities Degree: In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. About Us: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video . Celonis Inclusion Statement: At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. Your Privacy: Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process . Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations. The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. data.title: Marketing & Growth Project Manager - Meals
data.description: En bref Chez Picnic, nos clients sont au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. En tant que Meals Business Manager, tu seras le moteur de l'un de nos principaux leviers de croissance : les recettes. Avec un catalogue de plus de 1000 recettes et un planificateur de repas unique, notre ambition est claire : s'intégrer durablement dans le quotidien et les habitudes culinaires des Français. Pour y parvenir, tu collaboreras avec des développeurs de recettes, des analystes et des créatifs pour faire rayonner notre fonctionnalité recettes sur tous les canaux : in-app, paid social, newsletters, et bien d'autres. Ta mission : transformer chaque interaction en une invitation à cuisiner avec Picnic. Tes missions Planifier et exécuter des campagnes 360° : Concevoir et piloter de A à Z des campagnes cross-canal ambitieuses (comme notre campagne de Noël) pour offrir des expériences clients cohérentes, créatives et engageantes. Gérer les communications quotidiennes : Créer, planifier et optimiser l'envoi de newsletters, notifications push et autres communications régulières pour informer nos clients, nourrir leur inspiration culinaire et générer du trafic sur l'app. Valoriser nos fonctionnalités et notre assortiment : Mettre en avant les atouts de l'app Picnic et de notre offre produit avec créativité, pour inspirer et guider nos clients à chaque étape de leur parcours. Piloter la performance par la donnée : Concevoir et mener des A/B tests, analyser les résultats et traduire les insights en actions concrètes pour améliorer en continu la performance de nos campagnes. Contribuer à la croissance business : Identifier et mettre en place des actions ciblées et autonomes pour générer une demande supplémentaire et atteindre nos objectifs hebdomadaires. Collaborer avec les équipes Picnic : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe Meals internationale et les créatrices de recettes en local, ainsi qu'avec les analystes et créatifs, pour co-construire des campagnes à fort impact. À propos de toi Tu es diplômé·e d’un Master en Marketing, Business, Communication ou domaine connexe. Tu as entre 3 et 4 ans d’expérience à temps plein dans un rôle lié au growth marketing, à l’activation client ou à la gestion de campagnes digitales multicanales. Tu as déjà travaillé sur la promotion de fonctionnalités produit, de parcours in-app ou d’expériences digitales, avec une forte orientation acquisition et activation client. Tu as évolué dans un environnement exigeant et hands-on : startup, scale-up ou organisation avec un fort niveau d’autonomie et de responsabilité. Tu es à l’aise dans des environnements rapides et opérationnels, où les décisions ont un impact visible immédiatement. Tu as déjà piloté des campagnes ou projets créatifs impliquant de multiples stakeholders (Design, Copy, Business, Tech, agences, etc.) et sais faire avancer des sujets complexes jusqu’à une exécution irréprochable. Tu combines créativité et esprit analytique, et sais naturellement transformer des insights en actions concrètes. Tu es à l’aise avec Excel et capable de prendre des décisions basées sur des données. Le français est ta langue maternelle et tu maîtrises parfaitement l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit. Tu as une forte affinité pour l'univers de l'alimentaire et le goût des bonnes choses. Tu aimes mettre en valeur de façon authentique les bons produits, les producteurs et le terroir. Avantages Picnic 🍴 Restauration Comme nous sommes implantés au centre de Paris, pas de cantine sur place. Par contre, des tickets restaurant d’une valeur de 11€ par jour sont remis afin de tester tous les délicieux restaurants du coin. Notre petite cuisine est également équipée de savoureux en-cas et rafraîchissements. 🚲 Santé et transports Grâce à nos partenariats avec Sidecare et OpenUp, tu as la possibilité de souscrire à notre mutuelle d’entreprise ainsi qu’à un accès facile et gratuit à des psychologues professionnels, des ateliers et des outils pratiques. De plus, si tu te rends au travail en transports en commun, nous te remboursons ton abonnement à hauteur de 50%. ✍️ Développement personnel et professionnel Tu auras l’opportunité de développer tes compétences, non seulement au travers de projets stimulants, mais aussi grâce à un environnement dynamique, jeune et international. 🎫 Sorties et divertissement Profite d'un accès à des offres et avantages exclusifs via notre CSE et partenaire Swile (bons d'achats, places de concert, cinéma, et plus encore). Tu profiteras aussi d'inviations à tous nos événements récurrents comme notre très convoitée Summer Party ! Merci de soumettre votre candidature en anglais et de préparer un CV en anglais. data.title: Fullstack Web Developer
data.description: Overview We are looking for a hands-on Fullstack Web Developer to join our Web Apps team, in our Zürich office. In this role you will have the opportunity to drive development of new features, have a say in architecture and design decisions and have real impact across all the team’s projects. The web apps team plays a central role at Auterion and owns the systems that add connectivity and remote interfaces for fleet management and operations. Our services are responsible for ingesting and analyzing flight telemetry data, managing and updating the fleet as well as integrating with other systems across the stack. The ideal candidate is someone who’s a self-starter, can work independently, can work with ambiguity, can take decisions on their own and not be afraid to drive and push towards getting the project across the finish line. Responsibilities and Duties Take ownership and drive the development of new features across all the team’s web based projects Deliver clean, readable and maintainable code Integrate services between edge devices and our centralized services Handle new feature discovery, prototyping and investigations Assist the Customer Success team in debugging and resolving customer issues Monitor and analyze user usage patterns and other statistics Push initiatives to clean up, upgrade, and refactor existing services to reduce technical debt Maintain and improve integrations with 3rd party services Qualifications and Skills 4+ years of experience in a Fullstack web development or similar role. Strong proficiency with the Node.js ecosystem, development and tooling Strong proficiency with the Typescript ecosystem, development and tooling Strong proficiency with modern SPAs (Vue.js ecosystem preferred) Solid experience with Postgres/SQL (queries, transactions, views, indexes, triggers) as well as ORM systems (Prisma) Solid experience with Docker and container orchestration Solid experience with CI/CD pipelines (GoCD and GH Actions) Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Grafana) Python proficiency is a plus CH/EU citizenship required Benefits Flexible working hours Stock Options Generous holiday allowance Company pension plan Car parking Enhanced maternity & paternity leave Mental health and wellbeing support About Auterion We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems. At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters. data.title: Leiter Automatisierungstechnik Siemens TIA
data.description: About EH Group Engineering EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners. To help bring this vision to life, we are looking for a Senior Control Engineer to coordinate our efforts in designing control strategies for containerized systems integrating our fuel cell technology alongside equipment such as gas reformers, batteries, and climate control units. You will coordinate the control team and play a key role in shaping how these complex, multi-equipment systems operate safely and efficiently in the field. Based in the US? You’re welcome to apply. This is an on-site role in Nyon, Switzerland. We ask that you relocate within 3 months of starting, and we’ll support you with a relocation package. Key Responsibilities: Coordinate the control engineering activities and define the control architecture and technical roadmap for our fuel cell and containerized power systems Develop control strategies, models and algorithms for test-benches, fuel cell system and containerized power supply systems using Matlab/Simulink and Siemens PLCs Coordinate the transition of prototype control algorithms from Simulink to industrial-quality code in TIA Portal Step 7 Implement, tune and validate controllers for thermal, air, fuel and power subsystems Define and own control requirements, state machines and safety/diagnostic logic Drive the continuous improvement (performance, efficiency and robustness) of our products Define and oversee model-in-the-loop (MIL) testing and validation procedures Manage the complete software life cycle, from requirements through release and maintenance, including dataset management Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews and ensure compliance with industrial and certification requirements Coordinate and develop the control team, including task planning and prioritization Act as the main control interface with embedded, test and electrical engineering, as well as external partners and suppliers Skills and Experience Required: BSc/MSc in control, electrical, mechatronic or automation engineering is mandatory Minimum 7 years of experience in control engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical lead or senior role Skill 1 : Strong experience in process control engineering, particularly with containerized power supply systems; knowledge of programming and implementing safety PLCs is a strong plus Skill 2 : Strong experience with TIA Portal (Step 7, WinCC, Test Suite), with the ability to structure code to industrial standards and meet certification requirements Experience with functional safety (e.g. IEC 61508, ISO 13849), including SIL/PL determination and implementation of safety functions Experience across the complete V-model development cycle, including hazard and risk assessment, requirements definition, safety requirements specification (SRS), verification and validation, and dataset management Experience with stationary and maritime power applications, with a focus on the US and EU markets and their respective standards and certification requirements Proven team player, with the ability to: (i) Coordinate and mentor the control team by clearly explaining your code and helping the team adopt robust industrial methods: you will take the responsibility in developing Skill 1 and Skill 2 across the team (ii) Collaborate effectively within interdisciplinary teams Solid knowledge of control theory, state machines and system identification Strong experience with MATLAB/Simulink and model-based design is a plus Professional working language is in English. Start date: Immediately Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow
