The requirement is explicit: quality must be identical at both sites. Same specifications, same control plans, same acceptance criteria, same records. A customer taking delivery of a system should not be able to tell which site built the stack inside it, and our certification and warranty position depends on being able to demonstrate that. Our customers are data center operators, defense programs, and industrial sites where reliability is the product. In your first year you'd harmonize our quality management system across both entities, establish controls in Houston that match those proven in Nyon as manufacturing technology transfers, build supplier quality alongside Supply Chain for a shared global supply base, and support certification of our systems for both European and US markets. Location & travel: Nyon-based. Regular travel to Houston is expected as the US operation stands up, along with travel to supplier and partner sites in Europe and the US. What you'll own One quality management system across both entities — a common QMS covering Nyon and Houston, including the path to ISO 9001 certification in the US and alignment with what is already established in Switzerland. Equivalence between sites. A single set of product specifications, control plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards, with a defined process for how any change is applied at both sites rather than one. In-process quality for fuel cell stack production at both locations, including the process controls that matter most in stack assembly — cleanliness and contamination control, leak testing, torque and compression control, and alignment. Supplier quality for a shared global supply base , working with Supply Chain on qualification, audits, first article inspection, part submission, and ongoing performance, with one qualification standard regardless of which site a supplier serves. Quality oversight of contract manufacturing and assembly partners building balance of plant and containerized systems on our behalf in both regions — audits, quality agreements, source inspection, and acceptance criteria. Nonconformance and corrective action across both sites , including NCR and CAPA processes and structured problem solving, with findings at one site systematically applied at the other. Traceability and product records — a common lot genealogy model from raw material through stack serial to delivered system, and the test and inspection data that supports warranty, certification, and customer acceptance, held consistently across both entities. Certification across regions , working with external certification partners on the standards applicable to stationary hydrogen power systems in Europe and the US, authority having jurisdiction approvals, and marine classification where relevant. Quality culture on both floors , including operator training, work instruction discipline, and establishing the habits in Houston that are already proven in Nyon, as US headcount grows quickly. Building the US quality capability , defining what needs to sit on the ground in Houston versus what is run centrally from Nyon, and recruiting into it as volumes grow. Establishing or substantially rebuilding a quality function, including authoring a quality management system rather than administering an existing one. Hands-on in-process and incoming quality in a production setting, with real familiarity with control plans, inspection methods, measurement systems, and process capability. Supplier quality experience, including auditing suppliers and holding them to standard. Structured problem solving and root cause analysis, with a track record of permanently closing out recurring defects. Working knowledge of product certification processes and the evidence they require, ideally in energy, power equipment, or another regulated product category. Exposure to both European and US regimes is a strong advantage. The judgment to know which controls are essential at low volume and which can wait, and the confidence to hold a quality position under schedule pressure. Comfort working across time zones and influencing a site you are not physically based at, including building quality capability remotely. Especially compelling Fuel cell, battery cell, or similar electrochemical assembly experience. Experience with cleanliness-critical or contamination-sensitive assembly processes. Experience supporting a technology transfer between sites or countries, and establishing quality at the receiving end. Experience qualifying and auditing contract manufacturers or system integrators. Startup or scale-up experience as an early hire during hyper-growth. Experience working between Europe and the US, and with US codes and certification practice in particular. French is useful but not required. What we offer Competitive compensation and meaningful equity, calibrated to the market and discussed directly with you. Relocation support to Nyon, Switzerland. The opportunity to build EHG's global quality function during a defining phase of hyper-growth. Note: Swiss work authorization or eligibility is required for this role, along with the ability to travel to the United States. EH Group is an equal opportunity employer. data.title: DNA Synthesis Platform Engineer
data.description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role We're looking for a hands-on scientist-engineer to help build our next-generation DNA synthesis platform, enabling high-throughput, cost-effective production of large and diverse DNA libraries. You'll work at the intersection of chemistry, materials science, bioengineering, and hardware development, designing and building prototypes, running experiments, and optimizing processes to turn new synthesis technologies into reliable, scalable production systems. DNA synthesis is a fundamental part of our protein engineering platform. We're developing new approaches to dramatically increase synthesis throughput while reducing cost and turnaround time. You'll work closely with our scientific and engineering teams to develop and prototype new DNA synthesis technologies. Your focus will be on translating scientific concepts into working hardware and experimental systems, designing and building prototypes, testing different approaches, and continuously improving their performance. This is a highly hands-on, interdisciplinary role combining experimental science with practical engineering. You'll take ownership of prototype development, experimental validation, and process optimization, helping move promising technologies from early concepts to reliable, scalable systems. We're looking for someone who enjoys building things, solving technical problems, and working across disciplines. You don't need to be an expert in DNA synthesis, but you should have strong scientific fundamentals, an engineering mindset, and experience turning ideas into working prototypes. What You'll Do Design, build, and test prototypes for next-generation DNA synthesis technologies. Translate scientific and technical requirements into practical engineering designs and experimental setups. Scope and evaluate different technical approaches, components, materials, and equipment for prototype development. Develop and optimize the chemistry, materials, and processes underlying the synthesis platform. Design and execute experiments to characterize performance, identify limitations, and improve reliability. Work closely with mechanical, electronics, software, and automation engineers to develop integrated experimental systems. Troubleshoot complex technical problems across chemistry, hardware, and process engineering. Develop analytical methods and quality control strategies to measure performance and guide optimization. Help scale successful prototypes into robust, reproducible systems suitable for routine production. Work with external suppliers and engineering partners to source components, evaluate technologies, and accelerate development. What We're Looking For A strong background in chemical engineering, chemistry, materials science, bioengineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field. Hands-on experience designing, building, and testing experimental setups, prototypes, or laboratory equipment. Strong understanding of chemistry, materials, or process engineering, with the ability to apply these fundamentals to practical engineering challenges. Experience developing and optimizing experimental processes, including systematic troubleshooting and performance characterization. Comfortable working across hardware and experimental science, translating scientific requirements into practical engineering solutions. Experience selecting components, evaluating technical trade-offs, and iterating on prototype designs. Strong experimental skills, including designing experiments, analyzing data, and making decisions based on results. Independent, resourceful, and comfortable working on open-ended technical problems. A practical, hands-on approach to engineering, with a focus on building, testing, and improving systems rather than purely theoretical development. Experience with DNA or oligonucleotide synthesis, including chemical or enzymatic approaches, is a plus. Experience with solid-phase synthesis, surface chemistry, or chemical process development is a plus. Familiarity with microfluidics, high-throughput dispensing, or array-based technologies is a plus. Experience with laboratory automation, instrumentation, or custom hardware development is a plus. Experience with CAD, electronics, fluidics, or mechanical prototyping is a plus. Experience scaling experimental technologies from proof of concept to production is a plus. Programming and data analysis experience, particularly in Python, is a plus. data.description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role This is not a lab technician position. This is a senior scientist who owns assay quality, data QC and controls, and production troubleshooting across the entire experimental pipeline. The production team runs 150+ experiments per month across expression, BLI, SPR, thermostability, and enzyme activity. When something goes wrong (failed expression, anomalous binding data, instrument artifacts), this person diagnoses the root cause and fixes it. As the assay and instrumentation portfolio expands, this person translates new R&D methods into production-ready protocols, builds robust methods that junior technicians can execute reliably, and designs comprehensive controls that enable automated QC and data processing. This is a player-coach position. You will still run experiments personally, especially as you integrate into the lab, but you will also elevate the whole team's capabilities. What You'll Do Troubleshoot production failures across the full pipeline. A batch of proteins isn't expressing: is it the construct design, the expression system, or the media? BLI sensorgrams look noisy: is it the sensor tips, the sample prep, or an instrument issue? You figure it out, fix it, and make the cause easier to identify next time. Develop and document SOPs for new assays as the portfolio expands. Take methods from the R&D team and make them production-ready: robust, reproducible, and executable by junior technicians without hand-holding. Mentor a growing production team. Set quality standards, review data, train new hires, and build a culture where people flag problems early instead of hiding them. Work at the intersection of biology, automation, and QC. Collaborate with researchers, laboratory technicians, and automation engineers on protocol optimization for work cells, and with software on LabOS protocol integration. Own the relationship between assay science and throughput. The easy version of every assay doesn't scale, and the scalable version often sacrifices quality. You find the right tradeoff. What We're Looking For Deep hands-on expertise in protein production: expression (E. coli, mammalian, cell-free), purification (IMAC, SEC), and biophysical characterization (BLI and SPR at minimum). This isn't negotiable. You need to have done this work yourself, at volume. PhD in protein biochemistry, biophysics, or structural biology, plus 3-5 years in a production or development role at a CRO, foundry, or high-throughput lab. Academic postdocs count if the work was high-throughput and production-oriented. Experience with high-throughput workflows. You're comfortable with 96-well plates and liquid handlers, not just single-column purifications. You've optimized protocols for scale, not just for one perfect result. Mentorship mindset. You've managed or trained junior scientists before. You enjoy teaching and get satisfaction from watching your team grow. Troubleshooting instinct. When data looks wrong, your first impulse is to understand why, not to rerun the experiment and hope it works. Quality-obsessed but pragmatic. You care deeply about data quality, but you also understand that production has deadlines and sometimes "good enough" is the right call. Bridge between R&D and production. You can speak both languages: the exploratory mindset of research and the reproducibility demands of production. data.title: Senior Product Manager - Search & Ranking
data.description: At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car , a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton , Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe , we encounter exceptional objects every day. We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts. Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us. Taking ownership and driving impact Being open to change and feedback Being passionate about our mission and our customers. Your mission Every Product Manager at Catawiki owns a meaningful part of the customer experience. In Search and Ranking, your mission is to help buyers find the special objects they care about. You will shape how search, ranking and personalisation work across the buyer journey, making discovery more relevant and helping more buyers find objects they love. This is a broad product area. It brings together buyer needs, expert curation, marketplace priorities, search experiences and machine learning. You will identify the most important opportunities, set a clear direction and lead a cross functional team from insight to measurable customer and business impact. The solution is not prescribed. You may improve search relevance, ranking, recommendations or personalisation, or explore new AI enabled ways to help buyers discover objects. What matters is that you solve a meaningful customer problem, measure the impact and scale what works. You will own the strategy, outcomes and execution for this area, working closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing and Commercial teams. What you will do Set and communicate a clear product vision, strategy and roadmap for Search and Ranking. Own measurable outcomes across search relevance, discovery, engagement and buyer conversion. Use behavioural data, customer research and commercial insight to identify and prioritise the biggest opportunities. Turn ambiguous customer and business problems into clear hypotheses, prototypes and executable plans. Lead initiatives from early discovery through experimentation, launch and scaling. Define success metrics and build a rigorous experimentation agenda for search, ranking and personalisation. Work with machine learning engineers and data scientists to assess model quality, test new approaches and improve customer outcomes. Improve the relevance of search results and recommendations across the buyer journey. Integrate personalisation into the customer experience in ways that feel useful, coherent and trustworthy. Design, run and evaluate experiments, using positive, negative and inconclusive results to guide decisions. Use AI and rapid prototyping to test ideas early, reduce development risk and accelerate learning. Create clarity, momentum and accountability across teams, including when priorities or incentives differ. Communicate strategy, performance, tradeoffs and recommendations clearly to senior and C level stakeholders. Who you are Three qualities matter most in this role. Outcome ownership You take responsibility for customer and business results, not only for delivering features. You stay with the problem, remove obstacles and change direction when the evidence calls for it. Systems thinking You understand how search, ranking, recommendations, auction dynamics, expert curation and marketplace health influence one another. You make thoughtful decisions across the full buyer journey. Experimental rigour You use data, research, prototypes and controlled experiments to make decisions. You learn from negative results and can distinguish meaningful progress from activity. You will also bring: At least five years of product management experience, preferably in consumer ecommerce, marketplaces or another digital product at scale. Experience owning a broad product area or customer journey, rather than only individual features. Experience defining product strategy or roadmaps for search, ranking, recommendations, personalisation or other machine learning products. Confidence working with product metrics, experiments and commercial performance. Experience designing, running and analysing A/B tests, including tests involving machine learning products. The ability to turn uncertain opportunities into clear hypotheses, prototypes and plans. A practical understanding of machine learning concepts and how models become useful product experiences. Experience working closely with machine learning engineers and data scientists to develop and improve customer facing features. Comfort using AI tools to prototype quickly and explore customer experiences. The ability to balance immediate commercial opportunities with longer term product and platform investments. Clear communication skills and the ability to influence senior leaders without relying on formal authority. The pace, resilience and judgement to maintain a high standard of execution in an ambiguous environment. Where you will be This role is based in Amsterdam. We offer a relocation package for people currently living outside the Netherlands. Why You'll Love Working with Us Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business. Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression. A culture of connection defines us . We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work. Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion ” . We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location. Our Offices and Way of Working Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based. Interested? Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support the review of your application. AI may help us assess how your experience matches the requirements of the role, but hiring decisions are always made by our recruitment team Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Daarvoor moet elke schakel in onze operatie, van warehouse tot voordeur, dagelijks naadloos op elkaar aansluiten. Als Manager Operations Planning & Performance ben jij de spil tussen wat de klant bestelt en hoe wij dat logistiek waarmaken. Je brengt alle operationele schakels samen in één strakke, integrale planning en bouwt mee aan een betrouwbare operatie die klaar is om slim door te groeien. Wat je gaat doen Je bent eigenaar van de integrale operationele planning. Je vertaalt verwachte klantvraag naar concrete capaciteit op de weg (hoeveel bezorgers hebben we per dag en per hub nodig?) en bepaalt samen met de Operations Manager de planningsstrategie voor de korte en middellange termijn. Je zorgt voor een strakke planning tussen Delivery, Retentie en Warehouse. Zo werkt iedereen vanuit dezelfde basis en tilt jouw scherpe blik onze processen naar een hoger niveau. Je geeft leiding aan een team van routeplanners (werkstudenten en starters). Samen zorgen jullie dagelijks voor de meest efficiënte bezorgroutes. Jouw team staat in direct contact met de bezorghubs, het warehouse en de growth afdeling om de capaciteit af te stemmen Je werkt nauw samen met teams door de hele organisatie, van Tech en Analytics tot Recruitment. Om te weten wat er speelt, ben je regelmatig te vinden waar het gebeurt: op onze bezorghubs en in het warehouse. Je stuurt op operationele KPI’s (zoals Drops per Hour en Time per Stop ) en beheert belangrijke kostenlijnen. Samen met de Regiomanager en Business Analyst Delivery blijf je ons bezorgnetwerk continu optimaliseren. Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de lijn tussen ons warehouse en de hubs. Je onderhoudt de contacten met vrachtwagenvervoerders, stuurt op prestaties ( On Time ) en kosten ( Cost per Drop ) en maximaliseert de vulgraad. Je kijkt altijd naar wat beter kan, houdt trends en innovaties in de markt in de gaten en draagt dit actief aan wanneer je hier kansen ziet. Je signaleert kansen in de operatie, maakt de impact inzichtelijk en leidt verbeterprojecten van idee tot implementatie, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van servicetijd, automatisering van planningstaken of de inrichting van ons netwerk. Je bent onderdeel van het Delivery team en rapporteert aan de Head of Delivery. Dit ben jij Je hebt HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring in operationele planning, logistiek of supply chain, bij voorkeur in een snelgroeiende e-commerce- of retailomgeving. Je beweegt je makkelijk door de hele organisatie, van de vloer tot het management. Je zoekt actief de samenwerking op en krijgt verschillende teams moeiteloos op één lijn. Je creëert draagvlak en krijgt mensen mee in een gezamenlijke aanpak, ook als je geen formele zeggenschap over ze hebt Je bent sterk met data. Je duikt zelf in de cijfers, bouwt een model of dashboard als dat nodig is, en vertaalt analyses naar concrete keuzes voor de operatie. Ervaring met SQL, BigQuery en Data Studio is een pré. Jij kijkt verder dan je eigen scope en overziet de hele keten. Je begrijpt hoe een keuze in de planning doorwerkt in het warehouse, op de weg en bij de klant, en je weet de juiste balans te vinden tussen kosten en kwaliteit. Je bent resultaatgericht en weet wat het is om eigenaarschap te nemen. Jij maakt dingen graag makkelijk en concreet. Complexe vraagstukken zet jij gemakkelijk om naar begrijpelijke acties. Je houdt het hoofd koel als het even spannend wordt. Pieken, onverwachte uitval of last-minute wijzigingen brengen je niet van je stuk; je prioriteert, plant opnieuw en zorgt dat de operatie doordraait. Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Wat wij bieden Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem. 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden. Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen. Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp. Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL. Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University. Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven. Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor. Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen. En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten. Onze selectieprocedure Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter. Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd. data.title: Project Leider Bouw
data.description: Monumental automatiseert de bouw met robotica en software. Onze missie is om de bouw software-defined en autonoom te maken – een toekomst waarin mooie gebouwen op maat in één dag verrijzen, met minimale inzet van handwerk. We zijn een groeiend team van engineers, operators en technici, afkomstig van bedrijven als Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta en Google DeepMind. We staan nog aan het begin van het opbouwen van dit bedrijf, en dit is je kans om buitenproportioneel veel impact te maken op een probleem dat écht uitmaakt. Vanaf dag één werk je samen met een ervaren foundingteam, met een Series B van $32M achter ons onder leiding van Khosla Ventures en Plural. Monumental zit in het centrum van Amsterdam, in een prachtig pand met een volledig uitgeruste werkplaats en een eigen testvloer voor robots. We bouwen de hele stack in-house – hardware én software. We zijn uitdrukkelijk geen hybride of remote-first bedrijf: robots en muren bouw je niet vanaf je keukentafel, dus we werken vijf dagen per week op locatie. Lees meer over waarom wij vinden dat je je tijd aan de bouw zou moeten besteden, en over onze visie en ons bedrijf . Misschien vind je ons YouTube-kanaal interessant, de film van Based in Europe over hoe we het Europese woningtekort aanpakken , of deze video van Andreas Klinger over hoe ons kantoor eruitziet. Over de functie De afgelopen jaren is Monumental gegroeid van een werkend product en de eerste proefprojecten naar bouwen op grote schaal. Inmiddels hebben we een vloot van meer dan 150 robots, die metselwerk hebben uitgevoerd voor meer dan 90 woningen, een school, een buurthuis, een hotel en meer dan 150 meter kanaalwand. Elke maand nemen we meer bouwprojecten aan, intern noemen we die ‘deployments’. We werken met meer robots en meer mensen en breiden vanuit Nederland uit naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de VS. Als Hub Lead zet je onze eerste vestiging buiten het hoofdkantoor op, in het noorden van Nederland. Je begint met ons grootste bouwproject tot nu toe. Naarmate er meer projecten bijkomen, bouw je het team en de operatie verder uit. We zoeken mensen die breed inzetbaar zijn en een bouwproject willen leiden alsof het hun eigen bedrijf is. Achter elk project staat een Deployment Manager die van begin tot eind verantwoordelijk is. In de praktijk vervul je vijf rollen tegelijk: uitvoerder, operationeel manager, accountmanager, analist en projectmanager. Je maakt het bouwplan, voert het met je team als onderaannemer uit, onderhoudt het contact met de aannemer en zorgt dat we goed metselwerk op tijd opleveren. Dat doe je in de bouw, waar plannen voortdurend veranderen. Uiteindelijk leid je meerdere projecten tegelijk, waaronder complexe projecten waarbij veel op het spel staat. De ene dag sta je bij zonsopgang op en ga je naar de bouwplaats. Je zaagt stenen, bewaakt de planning, stemt af met de hoofdaannemer en ziet je bouwplan steen voor steen werkelijkheid worden. De volgende dag zit je op onze vestiging, analyseer je de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en werk je aan systemen waarmee je bij het volgende project een betere marge haalt. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de oplevering en geeft knelpunten die je op de bouwplaats tegenkomt door aan ons R&D-team. Dit is intensief, praktisch werk op locatie, waar je veel voldoening uit kunt halen. Robots gaan kapot, het weer slaat om en de aannemer verandert het plan. Jij zorgt dat de bouw doorgaat. Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. De rol past goed bij je als je eerder een bedrijf hebt opgericht, of als je een ondernemende functie zoekt waarin je veel invloed hebt op het resultaat. Wat je gaat doen De logistiek van een bouwproject plannen. Je bepaalt hoeveel en welke robots en mensen nodig zijn, stemt af met andere onderaannemers en maakt de dagelijkse planning. Tegelijk houd je het grotere geheel in het oog en begrijp je wat jouw keuzes betekenen voor de kosten en opbrengsten per project. Op de bouwplaats het team aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren. Je onderhoudt het contact met hoofdaannemers en andere betrokkenen, vertegenwoordigt Monumental en legt uit wat we doen. Je schakelt net zo makkelijk met steigerbouwers als met de CEO’s van de grootste hoofdaannemers en onze engineers. Operationele systemen opzetten waarmee elk project beter verloopt dan het vorige. Je ziet waar tijd en middelen verloren gaan, past processen aan en verbetert de marge. Samenwerken met bestaande klanten en zorgen dat daar nieuwe bouwprojecten uit voortkomen. In de toekomst doe je dat ook voor aanverwante productlijnen buiten het metselwerk. Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en voorstellen doen om de kosten en opbrengsten per project steeds verder te verbeteren. Helpen bij het werven en interviewen van nieuwe robotoperators en deployment operators. Wat we zoeken Minimaal drie jaar ervaring startupervaring, als operator, manager, of founder. Nederlands als moedertaal. De bouwsector is sterk lokaal georganiseerd, dus dit is een vereiste voor de functie. Je communiceert helder en makkelijk met mensen met uiteenlopende achtergronden. Je bent bereid om letterlijk je handen vuil te maken om het werk gedaan te krijgen. Je komt snel in actie, zet door en krijgt dingen voor elkaar. In deze functie draait het vooral om uitvoeren. Je kunt goed omgaan met hoge werkdruk. Op bouwplaatsen gaat regelmatig iets mis en staat er veel op het spel. Daar komt bij dat we nieuwe technologie inzetten waarvan we nog niet alle mogelijke storingen kennen. Je denkt scherp en leert graag. Welke achtergrond je ook hebt, je zult in deze rol veel en snel moeten leren. Het werk kan elke drie tot zes maanden als een nieuwe baan voelen. Je leert veel over de bouw, robotica en werken in een snelgroeiend technologiebedrijf. Je hebt ervaring met het aansturen van een klein team en weet hoe je mensen begeleidt en motiveert. Je bent operationeel en analytisch sterk. Je kunt een helder operationeel plan uitwerken in een spreadsheet, een winst- en verliesrekening presenteren en verschillende scenario’s doorrekenen, inclusief de factoren die het resultaat bepalen. Je bent een sterke projectmanager. Waarom Monumental? Bij Monumental werken betekent vooroplopen in een beweging die de bouwsector wezenlijk wil veranderen. Jouw werk heeft hier niet alleen impact op het bedrijf, maar op de toekomst van hoe we bouwen. Als je gedreven wordt door innovatie, graag complexe uitdagingen aanpakt en klaar bent om echt verschil te maken, horen we graag van je. Voor open sollicitaties (als je geen rol ziet die precies past) kun je ons mailen op: Helaas bieden we op dit moment geen stageplekken aan. Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen hierboven, maar ben je enthousiast over Monumental en denk je dat je ons toch kunt helpen moeilijke problemen op te lossen? Neem dan contact op. We verwelkomen generalisten die op resultaat gericht zijn en graag on the job leren. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

data.title: Director, Expanded Access Program Operations
data.description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. The opportunity: Director of EAP Operations (Expanded Access Programs and Site Management) This is a high‑impact leadership role at the heart of how myTomorrows delivers Expanded Access Programs (EAPs) globally—where operational excellence meets commercial acumen. As Director of EAP Operations, you’ll own the end‑to‑end operational delivery of our EAP portfolio, integrating Program Management and Site Management into one scalable, outcome‑driven model. Beyond ensuring quality, compliance, speed, and resilience, you’ll be expected to think like an entrepreneur: spotting opportunities, optimising processes, and driving commercially sound decisions that enable sustainable growth. You’ll be a core member of the Operations Leadership Team and report directly to our COO (Vanessa says hi). This role is perfect for someone who thrives on complexity, builds high‑performing teams, and raises the operational bar—while balancing patient‑first decision‑making with a strong commercial mindset. Geographic Requirement: This role is open to candidates in The Netherlands, United Kingdom, Canada and USA. For candidates in North America , to ensure seamless collaboration with our teams, applicants must reside within the EST or CST time zones . What you'll do in this role: Own the end-to-end operating model for EAP Program + Site Management, ensuring scalable and compliant delivery Translate strategy and portfolio forecasts into capacity planning, org design and hiring priorities Build resilient coverage and escalation models across the portfolio (no single points of failure) Lead the EAP Program Management team to deliver consistent execution across clients and geographies Lead the EAP Site Management team to ensure strong site engagement, workload balance and service performance Drive standardisation and continuous improvement across ways of working, tooling and operational excellence Set and run a strong governance rhythm: KPIs, performance reviews, risk management and quality oversight Act as senior escalation point for complex delivery, regulatory and stakeholder challenges Grow a bar-raising leadership bench through coaching, performance management and succession planning Partner with Finance, People and Operations on budgeting, workforce planning and scale-up decisions What you bring to the table: You have 8–10+ years experience leading and managing expanded access programs. Experience in a market access setting and with multi-country reimbursement strategies is a plus. You understand the EAP business, and have a strong and proven commercial and client service mindset. You have proven experience building and leading high performance teams. You know how to lead managers and scale operational teams in complex settings You have an exceptionally strong understanding of compliance, regulatory frameworks and operational requirements in the context of Expanded Access Programs You have a track record of operational excellence: scaling delivery, managing risk, and raising performance standards You are a strategic thinker with strong execution focus — you simplify complexity and drive outcomes You are a confident stakeholder manager who can align senior leaders and external partners You hold a high bar for quality and accountability, with calm leadership under pressure What success in the first 6 months looks like: Have full grip on the EAP portfolio and delivery realities — and you can clearly articulate the biggest operational opportunities and risks (and have recommendations on how to address them) Create clarity across Program & Site Management: ownership, workflows, escalation paths, and what “great” looks like Have strengthened the operating model to improve consistency, speed and resilience across the portfolio Have managed to deliver on the expected ramp-up of the EAP business both in terms of patients served, and revenue generated. Have implemented a clear KPI rhythm (quality, timelines, compliance, service levels) with transparent performance reporting Have improved capacity planning and coverage, educing single points of failure and enabling predictable delivery Have made at least 1–2 concrete operational improvements (process / tooling / standardisation) that measurably improve delivery outcomes Are seen as a trusted Operations Leadership Team member who raises the bar and builds momentum. Equal opportunities myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

data.title: Senior Customer Success Manager (Former Auditor) - Dutch Speaking
data.description: About the Role Former Auditor - Senior Customer Success Manager As a Senior Customer Success Manager (+Audit Background) at DataSnipper, you own the success of a portfolio of accounts - and you bring something additional to the role: direct experience in audit. You understand how audit teams work, what drives their priorities, and how to connect DataSnipper to the workflows that matter most inside a firm. You are a reliable, independent operator who applies established CS frameworks and uses your audit knowledge to accelerate adoption, build credibility with audit stakeholders, and design enablement that non-audit CSMs cannot replicate. You manage onboarding, QBRs, health monitoring, and renewals with predictability and follow-through and you do it in a language audit professionals trust. You may still be developing the full breadth of CS scope, but your audit domain credibility opens doors and unlocks conversations that are otherwise harder to access at this level. About DataSnipper Audit and finance are still massively manual and we are changing that. DataSnipper is a $1B, bootstrapped unicorn with 600,000+ users across 180+ countries, already embedded in the daily workflows of top audit and accounting firms. Now, we are taking things further with our Excel Agent, bringing AI directly into where the work actually happens. Unlike generic AI tools, we do not sit on the sidelines. Our AI operates inside Excel, with access to real documents and audit evidence, meaning it does not just generate answers, it does the work, with full traceability. We are not just applying AI, we are redefining how audit gets done. If you want to build something category-defining at scale, this is the place. What You Will Do Act as a Credible Audit Advisor: Serve as a trusted partner to Audit Managers, Senior Auditors, and engagement team leads. You are someone who understands customer workflows, their quality standards, and their firm's operating model. Translate DataSnipper's capabilities into language and use cases that resonate with audit professionals directly. Drive Adoption Aligned to Audit Workflows: Run onboarding and training sessions that are grounded in how audit teams actually work - mapping DataSnipper features to real engagement tasks, sample testing approaches, and evidence management requirements. Manage Account Health with Audit Context: Use product data, stakeholder signals, and your understanding of audit operating rhythms to monitor portfolio health. Recognize when signals carry firm-wide implications such as low adoption and respond or escalate with the right context. Build Audit-Grounded Success Plans: Create success plans that connect DataSnipper capabilities to audit-specific outcomes: engagement efficiency, sample coverage, review cycle speed, and quality compliance. Align milestones to audit calendar realities and firm methodology, not just generic product adoption targets. Communicate ROI in Audit Terms: Articulate the business impact DataSnipper delivers using metrics and framing that carry weight with audit professionals - time saved per engagement, risk reduction, quality improvement. Run QBRs and stakeholder conversations with the credibility of someone who has worked in the field. Support Expansion Using Domain Knowledge: Identify expansion signals within your portfolio and use your understanding of firm structure such as service lines, team hierarchies, engagement types to surface credible growth opportunities. Support Sales in building ROI cases that resonate with audit leadership. Collaborate Cross-Functionally with Audit Insight: Share audit workflow intelligence with Product, Sales, and Solutions Engineering. Surface patterns that require audit expertise to interpret - methodology gaps, adoption friction specific to audit processes, feedback that non-audit CSMs are less positioned to identify. Contribute Audit Knowledge to the Team: Help peers understand audit customer context. Act as an accessible internal resource for audit-specific questions to help raise the team's collective ability to serve audit accounts. Maintain Systems and Portfolio Data: Keep customer data, health signals, and portfolio records accurate and up to date in internal systems. Use this data to make better decisions and support reliable reporting. What You Bring Audit Domain Credibility: You have worked in or directly alongside audit teams. You understand engagement lifecycles, sample testing, evidence management, team hierarchies, and the quality standards that govern audit work. This is not background knowledge - it is something you apply directly in customer conversations and account planning. Experience: Ideally you have experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role in B2B SaaS, combined with direct experience in audit - whether as an auditor, audit technology specialist, or in a client-facing role embedded in audit workflows. You understand how audit engagements are structured, what drives adoption in audit teams, and how to speak credibly to audit professionals. Audit-Specific Enablement Design: You can design and execute onboarding and training programs that map to real audit workflows - including audit cycle timing, firm methodology, and engagement team structure. This requires audit fluency that cannot be substituted with general CS experience. Reliable Execution: You follow through. You manage a portfolio independently, hit your commitments, and deliver consistent outcomes without needing close supervision. Data-Driven Approach: You use product data and health signals to stay ahead of risks and make decisions. You are comfortable in CS tools and CRM platforms. Clear Communication across Contexts: You communicate clearly in both audit professional language and CS/GTM contexts. You can navigate stakeholder conversations with audit managers and firm leadership, and translate those conversations back into internal action. Ownership Mindset: You take responsibility for your accounts and your own development. You ask for feedback, apply it, and look for ways to improve. Collaborative Spirit: You contribute to the team including by sharing audit knowledge that makes peers more effective on audit accounts. Adaptability: You handle change well. You adjust when priorities shift and keep a constructive attitude in a fast-moving environment. Excellence in Communication: Professional fluency in English and Dutch (written and spoken), with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels - from audit associates to C-suite. What we offer Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact. Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share in the company’s success and growth. Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary. 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance. Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office. Daily, freshly prepared lunches to keep you energised. NS business card for easy commuting to the office. A structured onboarding programme designed to set you up for success, including dedicated time to learn our product and customers before you hit the ground running. Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills. Engage with a vibrant international team spread across seven global offices. Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together. Access to Nilo, a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience. Our hiring decisions are merit based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role. We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you. data.title: Team Lead, Data Engineering
data.description: We are looking for a Data Engineering Team Lead to lead the Data Platform team at DataSnipper. Every decision DataSnipper makes about its products runs through the data platform: which features land, which customers are getting value, what we bill for, what we fix next, and which AI capabilities add the most value. You will lead a team of two data engineers who own the systems that make that possible. That means how usage events get captured across a growing set of products, how they become trustworthy models in Snowflake, and how Customer Success, Product and GTM get to answers without waiting on us. This is a player-coach role in a small, high-ownership team . You are responsible for the people, the roadmap and the technical direction, and you stay hands-on enough to ship alongside the team and make architectural calls credibly. At DataSnipper, Team Lead is our entry point into engineering management: the same people, delivery and product responsibilities as an Engineering Manager, on a smaller team. We are a handful of people serving the whole company, so your judgment about what not to build matters as much as what the team ships. About DataSnipper DataSnipper is the driving force behind an intelligent automation platform that’s transforming the world of audit and finance. Founded in 2017, DataSnipper has skyrocketed and is now OFFICIALLY the fastest-growing software company in the Netherlands according to Deloitte Fast50 and recently achieved Unicorn status in our latest funding round. With over 400.000 users in 125+ countries and a second base in the heart of New York City, DataSnipper is shaking things up. And we’re not stopping there. At DataSnipper, we’re always on the lookout for innovators who think outside of the box. New ideas aren’t just welcomed at DataSnipper–they’re essential. What your team owns The Data Platform team works across three areas: Data Platform : reliable, scalable infrastructure that gets the right data to the right place Internal Analytics : a self-service platform so every team can be data-informed without a ticket Customer-facing Analytics : the dashboards and exports customers use to see the value they get from DataSnipper Concretely, you would be walking into billions of usage events flowing from our Excel Add-in, web apps and product backends through Azure Event Hubs into Snowflake ; a dbt estate built on medallion principles and managed in dbt Cloud ; Terraform-managed Snowflake and Azure infrastructure; and a set of product teams shipping AI agents faster than we can instrument them . You will also find real, named open problems rather than a tidy platform: event capture mid-consolidation, multiple methods of user attribution, and a data quality layer that is designed but not yet built. We would rather tell you that up front. What you will do Lead the team Lead a team of two data engineers through outcomes, not tasks : set clear goals with the team and trust them to figure out how Make the team measurably better: raise the engineering bar, grow each engineer into bigger problems, and address performance issues directly when they arise Run regular 1:1s, give clear and timely feedback, and own each engineer's goals and development Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, documentation and operational excellence Take part in hiring and help shape the team's scope as it evolves Own direction and delivery Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success and GTM to shape the team's roadmap , turning vague data requests into scoped, well-defined work Make the trade-offs a small team serving the whole company needs: what to build, what to defer, and when a request shouldn't become a pipeline Set the technical direction and make the architectural calls that shape the team's systems Keep Snowflake performance and cost , tech debt, dependencies and compliance obligations (audit logging, vulnerability remediation, Vanta evidence) visible and under control Be the person other engineering teams come to when they need to instrument something new Stay hands-on in the data platform Contribute to the event ingestion architecture end to end: Azure Event Hubs, Snowpipe, Fivetran, and our shared Python/TypeScript event client libraries Build and review dbt transformation pipelines that stay reliable as volume, source count and model complexity grow Define and enforce event contracts and schemas so product teams can instrument new features without silent breakage downstream Evolve the core data models (event, user, license, company) and integrate new sources such as product backends, MongoDB, HubSpot and billing Guide reverse ETL and activation work that pushes modeled data back into HubSpot, MongoDB, Postgres and GTM reporting What you bring Leadership At least 1 year leading engineers as a team lead or engineering manager: 1:1s, feedback, goal setting, performance, and development An empowerment style of leadership : you lead through outcomes and trust, not by assigning tasks Early evidence of growing engineers and raising a team's bar, and the willingness to address performance issues directly Strong product aptitude : you can challenge the framing of a request, data.title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
data.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases. Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner. Location: This role is open to candidates residing in Netherlands You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster. You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable. You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there. In this role, you will: Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends Minimum requirements for the role: 5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara's investigation processes, with proficiency in Python Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux Experience utilizing SIEM tools to perform log reviews Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services Participation in an on-call rotation, with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team. This role will be part of our EMEA so your hours will be aligned to the UK. As an operational time you may be expected to work flexible hours around this to support the load of the team An ideal candidate also has: 2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. data.description: Why Sony Interactive Entertainment? Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment, this senior leader will oversee a team of Lean experts and Operational Excellence business standardisation specialists, ensuring SIE Operations continues to improve service quality, reduce waste, increase efficiency, and deliver consistent, high-performing operational practices across all regions. Reporting into Global Operations, this role will act as a key transformation leader across the Operations division, partnering with Logistics, Warehousing, Planning, Transportation, Finance, Procurement, Commercial, D2C, Customer Service, and regional Operations teams to drive measurable improvements across cost, service, process maturity, and customer experience. What you’ll be doing: Lead the global Operations Excellence agenda for SIE, defining and executing a transformation roadmap focused on standardisation, Lean capability, service partner development, and continuous improvement. Oversee the Operations Lean Kaizen Office, driving Lean transformation activities across operational functions, including Kaizen events, value stream mapping, Gemba practices, waste reduction, cost improvement, and operational performance improvement. Oversee centralised budgetary analysis across Operations, supporting visibility, control, and governance of OPEX and CAPEX activities across the global supply chain. Generate data-driven insights into operational performance, ways of working, service quality, cost drivers, and customer impact, using these insights to shape strategic and continuous improvement initiatives. Identify opportunities to improve partner performance, cost efficiency, service delivery, and operational scalability. Drive Lean continuous improvement activities across all operational areas. Support weekly and monthly S&OE practices, ensuring continuous improvement is embedded into operational routines and decision-making. Lead and support Kaizen events, value stream mapping, Gemba walks, process diagnostics, and waste reduction initiatives. Deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, cost, service quality, process flow, and operational performance. Build Lean capability across teams through coaching, standards, tools, and practical application. Distribution Excellence Oversee global operational standardisation across distribution, warehousing, transportation, and fulfilment practices. Ensure SIE delivers one consistent, high level of operational service excellence to its global customer base. Develop data-driven insights into how operational practices impact customers, commercial outcomes, cost, and service performance. Act as the central funnel point for commercial and customer requests, translating business needs into operational realities. Identify global best practices and scale them across regions, partners, and operational functions. Establish performance metrics, governance forums, and improvement roadmaps to drive accountability and progress. What we’re looking for: 15+ years’ experience in Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Operational Excellence, Lean Transformation, or a related global leadership role. Proven experience leading Operational Excellence, Lean, continuous improvement, or business transformation programs. Strong understanding of global supply chain operations, including warehousing, transportation, distribution, 3PL/4PL management, and operational governance. Experience leading or supporting global tenders, service partner development, and supplier performance improvement. Strong financial acumen, with experience overseeing or analyzing OPEX, CAPEX, cost performance, and budgetary controls. Demonstrated experience with Lean tools and methodologies, including Kaizen, value stream mapping, Gemba, standard work, waste reduction, and continuous improvement routines. Strong ability to translate commercial and customer requirements into operational plans and scalable processes. Excellent leadership skills, with experience managing high-performing teams of specialists or transformation experts. Strong analytical capability, with the ability to turn operational data into strategic insight and measurable improvement. Excellent stakeholder management skills across Operations, Finance, Procurement, Commercial, Customer Service, and regional leadership teams. data.description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. About the Programme This is a structured 18–24 month global programme designed to launch high-potential commercial careers. You don’t need prior sales or payments experience; what you need is ambition, curiosity, resilience, and the drive to build relationships and solve complex problems. You will join a global cohort of Business Development Representatives (BDRs) with structured learning, dedicated coaching from sales leaders, and real commercial responsibility from month one. Throughout the programme, you will master enterprise sales: researching strategic accounts, engaging senior decision-makers, conducting sharp discovery conversations, and building pipeline that drives real business growth. High performers transition into Sales, Account Management, and other commercial roles across the business. Many of our top commercial leaders, including our Chief Revenue Officer, started their journey at Checkout.com as BDRs or interns. Whether you are a recent graduate, an early-career professional with 1–3 years of experience, or a career switcher, what matters most is your hunger to learn and achieve. What You’ll Do Research Strategic Accounts: Identify high-value targets by researching key organizations, industries, and executive stakeholders. Initiate High-Impact Outreach: Open doors with senior decision-makers using personalized outreach across email, phone, and LinkedIn. Build Qualified Pipeline: Drive consistent growth momentum through disciplined prospecting, rigorous follow-up, and account mapping. Run Consultative Discovery: Uncover merchants' technical and business challenges to align Checkout.com ’s solutions with their goals. Partner on Live Deals: Work alongside Sales Representatives to support opportunities through to deal execution. Leverage AI & Modern Tech: Use CRM, intent data, and approved AI tools to streamline research, refine outreach, and work smarter. Who We’re Looking For We welcome applications from recent graduates and professionals with 1–3 years of experience looking to change careers. Regardless of your background, we are looking for the following core skills to set you up for success: Driven & Goal-Oriented: You set high personal standards, work hard, and stay motivated when tackling challenging commercial goals. Resilient & Adaptable: You bounce back quickly from rejection, view obstacles as practice, and maintain consistent output. Relational & Engaging: You genuinely enjoy starting conversations, asking sharp questions, and building trust with diverse stakeholders. Track Record of Achievement: You demonstrate drive and ownership through professional, academic, athletic, or entrepreneurial success. Commercial & Tech Curiosity: You are eager to learn complex fintech products and use AI and sales tools to work smarter. Coachability & Clear Communication: You listen well, articulate ideas clearly, and actively apply feedback to improve performance. What You’ll Get Out of It A 2-year structured programme that ensures you have a successful career in sales. A clear progression pathway built around key pillars: Fintech & Enterprise Sales Mastery: Build deep expertise in global payments, digital commerce, and complex deal execution alongside experienced Account Executives. AI-Native Commercial Skills: Master modern sales tools, intent data, and AI to automate routine tasks and focus on high-impact prospecting. Coaching & Leadership Growth: Receive 1:1 mentorship from sales leaders, earn certifications, and take on senior BDR responsibilities, from mentoring peers to working on live deals through pricing and signing Direct Career Acceleration: Graduate with a tight-knit global network and a direct pathway into Account Executive, Account Management, or Commercial Strategy roles. Want to Stand Out? When we review your CV, ensure you show us why you're great for this role. Ensure and share something you’ve built, led or achieved, whether that’s hitting a target, launching a side project, or leading a team effort. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Who should apply? Recent graduates, early-career professionals (1–3 years experience), and career changers with strong commercial drive. When does the programme start? We have start dates in March and September 2027. What is the application deadline? Apply early for the best chance of being reviewed. We will close once we receive a sufficient number of applications. Where are the roles located? We have roles in London, New York, Barcelona, Amsterdam, Riyadh, Dubai, and Shanghai. Do I need a second language? Fluent English is required. Specific local language proficiency may be required depending on the hiring region. Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Life at Checkout.com We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection. Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us. data.title: Director - Power Systems and Grid Transformation
data.description: Company Description: Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance. As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with high-impact, on-the-ground work, partnering with business, finance, policymakers and civil society to deliver system change. With offices across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas, we are dedicated exclusively to sustainability-focused work. Director, Power Systems & Grid Transformation Location: Amsterdam ( preferred), or London Reports to: Eveline Speelman, Global Energy Platform Lead Role type: Full-time Role Overview Systemiq is seeking a Director with deep expertise in power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, system planning, flexibility, market design, utility transformation, and the integration of renewables at scale. This role will help clients address some of the most critical bottlenecks in the energy transition: grid constraints, connection queues, system adequacy, flexibility markets, transmission and distribution investment, regulatory reform, and the changing role of utilities and system operators. This is not a generalist energy transition role. We are looking for a senior strategy leader who understands how power systems actually work technically, commercially, and institutionally, and who can help clients unlock the grid, market, and system integration challenges now slowing the transition. This is a senior leadership role combining: Deep power systems expertise Top-tier strategy problem solving Origination and senior client leadership Delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programmes Team leadership and platform-building You will work closely with Eveline Speelman and global partners to build Systemiq’s work on power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, flexibility, market design, utilities, and system-level decarbonisation. Key Responsibilities Power Systems & Grid Transformation Lead work on power system transformation, including grid constraints, transmission and distribution investment, system planning, flexibility, renewables integration, and utility transformation. Advise clients on the strategic, regulatory, commercial, and institutional choices needed to accelerate power system decarbonisation. Translate technical power system challenges into clear strategic recommendations for senior decision-makers. Identify the practical barriers slowing power system transformation and shape interventions to overcome them. Strategic Advisory Lead high-impact strategy engagements with corporates, governments, investors, utilities, system operators, and other energy system actors. Structure and solve complex, ambiguous problems and translate them into actionable recommendations. Advise senior stakeholders, including C-suite leaders and policymakers, on transition pathways, investment priorities, and market-shaping decisions. Systems Change & Platform Leadership Shape and drive system-level interventions beyond individual projects, including coalitions, market-shaping initiatives, and public-private collaboration. Identify structural bottlenecks across policy, infrastructure, regulation, market design, and capital allocation. Work across sectors and stakeholders to unlock system-wide impact beyond project-level outcomes. Contribute to Systemiq’s broader Energy platform strategy and thought leadership. Origination & Growth Identify, shape, and win new work across power systems, grids, utilities, flexibility, and energy transition topics. Build trusted relationships with senior clients, partners, and external stakeholders. Contribute to scaling Systemiq’s Energy platform globally. Team Leadership Lead and mentor high-performing teams. Coach and develop team members, building capability in power systems, analytical problem solving, and systems-level thinking. Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and mission-driven culture. Candidate Profile We are looking for a high-calibre, strategy-led leader with deep power systems expertise and the ability to operate at the intersection of strategy, policy, regulation, infrastructure, and real-economy delivery. Essential Experience Deep experience in power systems, ideally including transmission and distribution grids, system operation, power market design, flexibility, renewables integration, storage, demand response, or utility strategy Around 10 to 15+ years’ experience in strategy consulting or energy advisory Experience working with or advising utilities, TSOs, DSOs, regulators, energy ministries, market operators, developers, infrastructure investors, or major energy users. Strong understanding of how grid constraints, interconnection, flexibility, storage, demand response, market reform, and regulation affect decarbonisation pathways. Ability to translate technical power system issues into strategic choices for senior decision-makers. Proven track record leading strategy engagements, complex programmes, and senior client relationships. Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders, including C-suite leaders, policymakers, regulators, and investors. Experience combining advisory work with real-world implementation is strongly valued. Core Capabilities Exceptional problem structuring and analytical rigour. Strong commercial judgement and experience in origination and growth. Ability to move between high-level strategy and practical implementation. Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills. Systems thinker focused on practical, scalable, real-world outcomes. Ability to lead complex work across multiple stakeholders, sectors, and geographies. Desirable Experience Experience in international energy systems, infrastructure investment, large-scale transition programmes, or power market reform. Experience with digital, AI, or advanced analytical tools that improve insight generation, modelling, or delivery efficiency. Experience building new areas of work, propositions, or client relationships. Mindset Entrepreneurial and opportunity-driven. Comfortable with ambiguity and building new areas of work. Collaborative, low ego, and mission-driven. Pragmatic, intellectually rigorous, and focused on real-world impact. Why This Role Matters Power systems are now one of the central constraints in the energy transition. Renewables, electrification, storage, flexibility, industrial decarbonisation, and clean technology deployment all depend on power systems evolving faster than they are today. This role sits at the centre of that challenge. It will help clients and partners address the grid, market, regulatory, and institutional barriers that determine whether economy-wide decarbonisation can happen at the pace required. Diversity & Inclusion At Systemiq, we absolutely believe diverse perspectives are essential to driving system change. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where people feel respected, supported and able to do their best work. Click here to view our Data Policy. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
